request: Delete the "guests this week" stat.
program_before:
app "Shaadi Catering" gift plum
table event client text, date date, guests num 20..2000 = 200, rate money, advance money = 0, kind pick Wedding|Walima|Mehndi|Birthday|Corporate = Wedding
setting heads num = 800 "Guests I can serve a week"
let total = sum(event, it.guests * it.rate)
let balance = sum(event where date >= today, it.guests * it.rate - it.advance)
topbar event, "Book event"
statcard balance, "still to collect from" count(event where date >= today) "events"
row gap 2
  stat count(event where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "events this week"
  stat sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "guests this week"
  stat sum(event.advance where date >= today), "advance held"
goal sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), heads, "of weekly capacity", "guests"
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each event where date >= today sort date top 6 as e empty "No upcoming events. Add the next booking."
    row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
      stack grow gap 0
        e.client e.kind bold
        e.date "-" e.guests "guests" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        e.guests * e.rate - e.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Events by kind", "all time"
  share event by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Revenue per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(event month of it, it.guests * it.rate), monthname(it)
section "Booked value", "all events"
  stat total, "total booked"
section "Guests per kind", "upcoming"
  each options event.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) / max(sum(event.guests where date >= today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each event top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.client bold
        x.kind x.date faint
      x.guests "guests" bold

app "Dairy Log" milk blue
table milk cow pick Gauri|Laali|Moti|Kali|Chandni = Gauri, litres num 1..40 = 8 unit "L", shift pick Morning|Evening = Morning
setting price money = 140 "Price per litre"
setting goal num = 60 "Daily herd goal (L)"
state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)
topbar milk, "Add milking"
statcard today_l, "litres today of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat today_l * price, "earned today"
  stat sum(milk.litres week) * price, "earned this week"
section "Shift view"
  choice sh
  each options milk.cow as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 90
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) / 12, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last 7 days", "average" round(sum(milk.litres last 7 days) / 7) "L a day"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(milk.litres on it), goal
section "Best cows this month", "litres"
  share milk month by cow, sum(it.litres), it.key
list milk today by day, "No milking logged today. Add the morning shift first."
section "Evening against morning", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Evening), "L evening"
section "Litres per day", "last 14 days"
  trend days last 14 days, sum(milk.litres on it)
section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"
    stat round(sum(milk.litres month) / max(count(days month, count(milk on it) > 0), 1)), "L a day"
section "Milk per shift", "this week"
  each options milk.shift as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if today_l >= goal
  "Daily goal reached." color good bold

app "Study" school mint
table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 25m "Focus length"
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

state rent money = 0
state n1 text = "Master room"

state b num = 2
state c num = 1

field rent "Monthly rent"
section "Rooms", plural(parts, "share")
  row gap 2

    "x" a bold

  row gap 2
    field n2
    "x" b bold
    slider b 1..6
  row gap 2
    field n3
    "x" c bold

      n2 grow
      round(rent * b / parts) bold
    row
      n3 grow
      round(rent * c / parts) bold
else
  "Type the rent to see each share." faint

app "Salon Book" smile pink

        b.client bold
        b.service faint
      b.price bold

section "Busy days", "next 14 days"

section "Free chairs", "this day"
  stat chairs - count(booking where day = d), "more clients can fit"
section "Services this week", "count"
  share booking week by service, count(it), it.key
section "Weekly takings", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(booking.price where day = it)

  each booking where day = d sort slot top 1 as b empty "No bookings. Time for tea."
    row card gap 2
      b.slot head
      b.client bold grow
      b.service faint

  each options booking.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(booking week where service = v) faint

Current program:
app "Typing" pen blue
table test wpm num 5..250 unit "wpm", accuracy num 50..100 = 95 unit "%", minutes num 1..30 = 1
setting goal_wpm num = 60 "Goal speed (wpm)"
let best = max(test.wpm)
let avg_wpm = round(avg(test.wpm last 7 days))
topbar test, "Log test"
row gap 2
  statcard best, "best wpm, goal" goal_wpm, goal_wpm
  statcard avg_wpm, "average wpm, last 7 days"
  statcard round(avg(test.accuracy last 7 days)), "% accuracy"
section "Speed over time", "last 30 days"
  trend test last 30 days, it.wpm
section "Accuracy over time", "last 30 days"
  trend test last 30 days, it.accuracy
section "Tests per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(test on it)
section "Practice days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(test on it), 3
section "Words typed", "all time"
  sum(test, it.wpm * it.minutes) big
  "words in" count(test) "tests" faint
section "Gap to the goal"
  max(goal_wpm - avg_wpm, 0) big
  "wpm to gain, about one wpm a week is normal" faint
section "Streak"
  streak(test) "days in a row" big
section "Tests"
  list test by day, "No tests yet. Take a one-minute test and log it."
row gap 2
  statcard count(test week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(test prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(test) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(test year) faint
  "Last one" since(test) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(test where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(test on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(test.wpm) * 10) / 10 "wpm" big
  "Highest" max(test.wpm) "wpm" faint
  "Lowest" min(test.wpm) "wpm" faint

program_before:
app "Gala Tickets" gift purple dark
table ticket buyer text, kind pick Adult|Child|VIP = Adult, qty num 1..20 = 1, price money
setting seats num = 300 "Seats in the hall"
setting goal money = 500000 "Fundraising goal"
setting event date = 2026-12-20 "Event date"
let sold = sum(ticket.qty)
let raised = sum(ticket, it.qty * it.price)
topbar ticket, "Sell tickets"
statcard raised, "raised of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat event - today, "days to the dinner"
  stat sold, "seats sold"
  stat seats - sold, "seats left"
goal sold, seats, "seats filled", "seats"
section "Ticket kinds"
  share ticket by kind, sum(it.qty), it.key
section "Money by kind", "raised"
  bars ticket by kind, sum(it, it.qty * it.price), it.key
section "Sales per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(ticket.qty on it)
section "Pace", "tickets needed each day"
  row gap 2
    stat max(round((seats - sold) / max(event - today, 1)), 0), "seats a day to fill the hall"
    stat max(round((goal - raised) / max(event - today, 1)), 0), "raised a day to reach the goal"
section "Biggest buyers", "top 3"
  each ticket sort qty desc top 3 as t empty "No tickets sold yet. Sell the first table."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      stack grow gap 0
        t.buyer bold
        t.kind faint
      t.qty "seats" bold
if sold >= seats
  "Sold out." color good bold
list ticket by day, "No tickets sold yet."
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each ticket top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.buyer bold
        x.kind faint
      x.qty "seats" bold

app "Chess Club" game ink
table player name text
table game p1 ref player, p2 ref player, result pick First_won|Draw|Second_won = Draw, moves num 5..200 = 40 "Moves played"
setting rounds num = 10 "Games each player should play"
let pts(p player) = count(game where p1 = p and result = First_won) + count(game where p2 = p and result = Second_won) + count(game where (p1 = p or p2 = p) and result = Draw) / 2
let played(p player) = count(game where p1 = p or p2 = p)
"Chess Club" head
statcard count(game), "games played by" plural(count(player), "player"), count(player) * rounds / 2
section "Standings", "points: win 1, draw half"
  each player sort pts(it) desc as p empty "No players yet. Add the members below."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      text index + 1 bold
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "games" faint
      pts(p) big
section "Points", "top 5"
  bars player sort pts(it) desc top 5, pts(it), it.name
section "Games per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, count(game week of it), monthday(it)
section "Results", "all games"
  share game by result, count(it), it.key
section "Latest games"
  each game top 5 as g empty "No games yet. Record the first result."
    row gap 2
      g.p1.name bold grow
      "vs" faint
      g.p2.name bold grow
      g.result faint
form player, "Add player"
form game, "Record game"
section "Games played", "per player"
  each player sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "of" rounds faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(played(p) / max(rounds, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Draw rate"
  goal count(game where result = Draw), max(count(game), 1), "games drawn", "draws"

table game p1 ref player, p2 ref player, result pick First_won|Draw|Second_won = Draw, moves num 5..200 = 40 "Moves played"
setting rounds num = 10 "Games each player should play"
let pts(p player) = count(game where p1 = p and result = First_won) + count(game where p2 = p and result = Second_won) + count(game where (p1 = p or p2 = p) and result = Draw) / 2
let played(p player) = count(game where p1 = p or p2 = p)
"Chess Club" head
statcard count(game), "games played by" plural(count(player), "player"), count(player) * rounds / 2
section "Standings", "points: win 1, draw half"
  each player sort pts(it) desc as p empty "No players yet. Add the members below."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      text index + 1 bold
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "games" faint
      pts(p) big
section "Points", "top 5"
  bars player sort pts(it) desc top 5, pts(it), it.name
section "Games per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, count(game week of it), monthday(it)
section "Results", "all games"
  share game by result, count(it), it.key
section "Latest games"
  each game top 5 as g empty "No games yet. Record the first result."
    row gap 2
      g.p1.name bold grow
      "vs" faint
      g.p2.name bold grow
      g.result faint
form player, "Add player"
form game, "Record game"
section "Games played", "per player"
  each player sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "of" rounds faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(played(p) / max(rounds, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Draw rate"
  goal count(game where result = Draw), max(count(game), 1), "games drawn", "draws"

table service name text, price money
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3
table visit client ref client, service ref service, paid money
let income = sum(visit.paid month)
screen home "Today" calendar
  stat income, "income this month"
  stat count(visit today), "appointments today"
  form visit, "Book appointment"
  each visit today as v
    row card
      v.client.name bold grow
      v.service.name
      v.paid
screen clients "Clients" users
  each client sort name as c
    row card tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name bold grow
      count(c.visit) "visits" faint
  form client, "Add client"
screen prices "Prices" tag
  list service
  form service, "Add service"
screen stock "Stock" package
  each product sort qty as p
    row card gap 1 tap edit p
      p.name bold grow color if(p.qty <= p.low, warn, ink)
      button "-" tap set p.qty = p.qty - 1
      p.qty bold
      button "+" tap set p.qty = p.qty + 1
  form product, "Add product"
screen money "Income" wallet
  stat income, "this month"
  stat sum(visit.paid prev month), "last month"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(visit.paid on it)
  list visit by day

app "Hen House" egg yellow
table collect eggs num 0..2000, broken num 0..200 = 0
table feed bags num 1..50 = 1, cost money
setting flock num = 400 "Birds in the flock"
let eggs_today = sum(collect.eggs today)
topbar collect, "Log eggs"
statcard round(eggs_today * 100 / flock), "percent laying rate, from" eggs_today "eggs", 100
row gap 2
  stat sum(collect.broken today), "broken today"
  stat sum(collect.eggs week), "eggs this week"
  stat round(sum(collect.eggs week) / 12), "dozen this week"
section "Eggs per day", "last 30 days"
  trend days last 30 days, sum(collect.eggs on it)
section "Collecting days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(collect on it), 2
section "Feed", "bags this month" sum(feed.bags month)
  row gap 2
    stat sum(feed.cost month), "feed cost"
    stat round(sum(feed.cost month) / max(sum(collect.eggs month), 1) * 100) / 100, "feed cost per egg"
  each feed top 3 as f empty "No feed bought yet. Add a purchase below."
    row gap 1
      f.bags "bags" grow
      f.cost bold
form feed, "Add feed"
list collect today, "No eggs logged today. Log the morning round."
section "Broken eggs", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(collect.broken on it)
section "Best day this month", "eggs"
  stat max(days month, sum(collect.eggs on it)), "eggs in one day"
section "Dozens to sell", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat floor(sum(collect.eggs week) / 12), "full dozens"
    stat sum(collect.eggs week) % 12, "loose eggs"
if sum(collect.broken week) * 20 > sum(collect.eggs week)
  "More than 5 percent broke this week. Check the trays." color warn bold
section "Laying rate", "last 7 days"
  each days last 7 days as d
    row gap 2
      dayname(d) grow
      sum(collect.eggs on d) "eggs" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(collect.eggs on d) / flock, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Special days Pro" gift plum
table event name text, kind pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday, day date, alert date, gift text?, budget money?
state n text = ""
state k pick Birthday|Anniversary = Birthday
state dt date = today
state g text = ""
state b money = 0
field n "Name"
choice k
field dt "Date"
field g "Gift idea"
field b "Budget"
button "Add" tap add event name = n, kind = k, day = dt, alert = dt - 7, gift = g, budget = b then set n = "" then set g = ""

    stack grow
      e.name bold
      e.kind e.day faint
      e.gift faint
    e.budget
    if e.day < today
      button "Next year" tap set e.day = addmonths(e.day, 12) then set e.alert = addmonths(e.alert, 12)
"Budget for upcoming" sum(event where day >= today, it.budget) faint

table usage kid pick Ayan|Hira = Ayan, mins num 5..600 unit "min", kind pick Games|Videos|School|Chat = Videos

section "School time", "this week"

  "Games and videos" sum(usage.mins week where kind = Games or kind = Videos) "min" faint

section "Per child this week"

app "Orchard" apple yellow
table picking block pick Mango_A|Mango_B|Guava|Citrus|Pomegranate = Mango_A, crates num 1..300 = 20, grade pick Export|Local|Juice = Local
setting target num = 1200 "Season target (crates)"
setting price money = 900 "Price per crate"
let crates = sum(picking.crates)
topbar picking, "Log picking"
statcard crates, "crates picked of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat crates * price, "value at price"
  stat sum(picking.crates today), "crates today"
  stat sum(picking.crates where grade = Export), "export grade"
section "Crates per block", "season"
  bars picking by block, sum(it.crates), it.key
section "Picking", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(picking.crates on it)
section "Grade mix"
  share picking by grade, sum(it.crates), it.key
section "Pace", "to reach the target"
  each days last 7 days as d
    row gap 2
      dayname(d) grow
      sum(picking.crates on d) "crates" faint
section "Best day", "this season"
  stat max(days month, sum(picking.crates on it)), "crates in one day"
list picking today, "Nothing picked today. Log the first crates."
section "Crates per block", "against a third of target"
  each options picking.block as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(picking.crates where block = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(picking.crates where block = v) / max(target / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each picking top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.block bold
        x.grade faint
      x.crates "crates" bold

app "Deploys" bolt slate dark
table deploy service pick Web|API|Worker|Docs = Web, version text, result pick Success|Rolled_back|Failed = Success, mins num 1..120 = 6 unit "min"
setting slow num = 15 "Slow deploy limit (min)"
let rate = round(count(deploy where result = Success) * 100 / max(count(deploy), 1))
topbar deploy, "Log deploy"
row gap 2
  stat rate, "percent succeeded"
  stat count(deploy week), "deploys this week"
  stat round(avg(deploy.mins)), "average minutes"
if count(deploy where mins > slow) > 0
  "Slow deploys:" count(deploy where mins > slow) "over" slow "minutes" color warn bold
section "Deploys per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(deploy on it)
section "By service", "all time"
  share deploy by service, count(it), it.key
section "Duration", "last 14 days"
  trend deploy last 14 days sort at, it.mins
each deploy top 8 as d empty "No deploys logged yet. Log the next release."
  row card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d
    stack grow gap 0
      d.service d.version bold
      d.at faint
    d.mins "min" color if(d.mins > slow, warn, ink)
    d.result color if(d.result = Success, good, bad)
section "Failures", "last 30 days"
  daybars last 30 days, count(deploy on it where result != Success)
section "Slowest deploys", "top 3"
  each deploy sort mins desc top 3 as d empty "No deploys yet."
    row gap 2
      d.service d.version bold grow
      d.mins "min" color warn
section "Rolled back", count(deploy where result = Rolled_back)
  list deploy where result = Rolled_back top 4, "No rollbacks. Keep it that way."
section "Results", "all deploys"
  each options deploy.result as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(deploy where result = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(deploy where result = v) / max(count(deploy), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last deploy"
  each deploy top 1 as d empty "No deploys yet."
    row card gap 2
      d.service d.version bold grow
      d.result faint

app "Solar payback" sun purple
state kw num = 5
state cost money = 150000
state sun num = 4
state tariff money = 40
state loss num = 0.5

let paid_back = cost * kw / max(yearly, 1)
let left10 = pow(1 - loss / 100, 10)
section "Your system"
  "Size" kw "kW" faint
  slider kw 1..20
  field cost "Cost per kW"
  "Sun hours (units per kW a day)" sun faint
  slider sun 2..6
  field tariff "What you pay per unit"
  "Panel loss per year" loss "%" faint
  slider loss 0..2
if yearly = 0
  "Fill in the prices to see how fast it pays back." faint
else
  statcard round(paid_back * 10) / 10, "years to pay back"
  row gap 2
    stat round(yearly), "saved in year one"
    stat round(left10 * 100), "% output after 10 years"
  section "Total saved over 10 years", "minus cost"
    trend 1..10, yearly * it - cost * kw

program_before:
app "Data per GB" bolt pink
state p1 money = 300
state g1 num = 5
state p2 money = 900
state g2 num = 20
state p3 money = 1500
state g3 num = 50
state need num = 10
let r1 = if(g1 > 0, p1 / g1, 0)
let r2 = if(g2 > 0, p2 / g2, 0)
let r3 = if(g3 > 0, p3 / g3, 0)
let best = min(min(r1, r2), r3)
section "Pack 1"
  field p1 "Price"
  field g1 "GB"
section "Pack 2"
  field p2 "Price"
  field g2 "GB"
section "Pack 3"
  field p3 "Price"
  field g3 "GB"
row gap 2
  statcard round(r1 * 10) / 10, "per GB, pack 1"
  statcard round(r2 * 10) / 10, "per GB, pack 2"
  statcard round(r3 * 10) / 10, "per GB, pack 3"
"Cheapest is pack" if(best = r1, 1, if(best = r2, 2, 3)) big color good
field need "GB I need a month"
"That costs about" round(best * need) bold

app "Flags" flag plum dark
table flag name text, env pick Dev|Staging|Prod = Dev, owner pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali, on bool, risk num 1..5 = 2 "Risk (1 to 5)"
setting stale num = 30 "Stale after (days)"
let live = count(flag where env = Prod and on = yes)
let old = count(flag where on = yes and at < today - stale)
topbar flag, "Add flag"
row gap 2
  stat live, "on in production"
  stat count(flag where on = yes), "on anywhere"
  stat old, "stale and still on"
if old > 0
  "Clean up" plural(old, "flag") "older than" stale "days." color warn bold
grid 3 gap 1
  each options flag.env as e
    stack card gap 0
      e bold
      count(flag where env = e and on = yes) big
      "of" count(flag where env = e) faint
each flag sort env as f empty "No flags yet. Add the first one with Add flag."
  row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
    toggle f.on
    stack grow gap 0
      f.name bold
      f.env "-" f.owner faint
    if f.on = yes and f.at < today - stale
      "Stale" color warn bold
section "Flags per owner"

section "Created per week", "last 6 weeks"
  bars days last 6 weeks, count(flag week of it), monthday(it)

section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each flag top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold

table lead company text, stage pick New|Contacted|Proposal|Won|Lost = New, value money, next date?

topbar lead, "Add lead"
statcard won, "won of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(lead.value where stage = Contacted or stage = Proposal), "in the pipeline"
  stat count(lead where stage = Won), "deals won"

app "Fish Pond" fish blue
table check pond pick A|B|C = A, temp num 15..40 = 26 unit "C", feed num 0..50 = 5 unit "kg", dead num 0..500 = 0
setting stock num = 3000 "Fish stocked"
let alive = stock - sum(check.dead)
topbar check, "Log check"
statcard alive, "fish alive of" stock, stock
row gap 2
  stat round(avg(check.temp last 7 days) * 10) / 10, "average temp this week"
  stat sum(check.feed week), "kg fed this week"
  stat sum(check.dead week), "lost this week"
section "Checked today"
  row gap 1
    each options check.pond as p
      stack card grow gap 0 align center
        p bold
        if(count(check today where pond = p) > 0, "Done", "Not yet") faint color if(count(check today where pond = p) > 0, good, warn)
section "Water temperature", "last 14 days"
  trend check last 14 days sort at, it.temp
section "Feed per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(check.feed on it)
section "Losses by pond"
  share check by pond, sum(it.dead), it.key
list check top 6, "No checks yet. Log the first pond visit."
section "Dead fish", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(check.dead on it)
section "Survival", "since stocking"
  goal alive, stock, "fish alive", "fish"
if avg(check.temp last 3 days) > 32
  "Water is warm. Feed less and add aeration." color warn bold
section "Feed per pond", "all time"
  share check by pond, sum(it.feed), it.key
section "Feed per pond", "this week"
  each options check.pond as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(check.feed week where pond = v) "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(check.feed week where pond = v) / max(sum(check.feed week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each check top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.pond bold
        x.temp "C -" x.feed "kg fed" faint
      x.dead "lost" bold

state d new entry
"How are you feeling?" head
row gap 1
  each ["Awful", "Low", "Okay", "Good", "Great"]
    stack grow align center tap set d.mood = index + 1
      draw width 44
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft)
        rect 30, 74 - 12 * index, 40, 8 + 12 * index fill bg radius 3
      it tiny
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
row gap 2
  stat streak(entry), if(count(entry today) > 0, "day streak, including today", "day streak; write today to keep it")
  stat count(days last 14 days, count(entry on it) > 0), "of 14 days written"
row gap 1
  each days last 14 days
    box grow height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(entry on it) > 0, accent, soft)
"Mood this week" round(avg(entry.mood week)) "vs" round(avg(entry.mood prev week)) "last week" faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
if q != "" and count(entry where has(note, q)) = 0
  "Nothing found. Try a shorter word." faint
list entry where has(note, q) by day
"Saved on this device only." faint

table booking player text, court pick Court_1|Court_2|Court_3 = Court_1, slot pick Six_pm|Seven_pm|Eight_pm|Nine_pm = Six_pm, day date = today, fee money = 1200
setting slots num = 12 "Slots available a day"
state d date = today
let taken = count(booking where day = d)
topbar booking, "Book court"
row gap 1 align center
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  d bold grow align center
  button ">" tap set d = d + 1
goal taken, slots, "slots booked on this day", "slots"
section "Slot grid", "tap a free slot for a quick booking"
  each options booking.court as c
    row gap 1
      c bold width 70
      each options booking.slot as s
        if count(booking where day = d and court = c and slot = s) = 0
          box height 40 radius 6 fill soft grow tap add booking player = "Walk-in", court = c, slot = s, day = d
            s tiny align center
        else
          box height 40 radius 6 fill accent grow
            s tiny align center color bg
row gap 2
  stat sum(booking.fee where day = d), "income this day"
  stat slots - taken, "free slots"
section "Income", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(booking.fee where day = it)
section "Courts", "bookings this month"
  share booking month by court, count(it), it.key
section "Bookings", "this day"
  each booking where day = d sort slot as b empty "Nobody booked yet for this day."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.player bold
        b.court b.slot faint
      b.fee bold
section "Peak hours", "bookings this month"
  each options booking.slot as s
    row gap 2
      s bold grow
      count(booking month where slot = s) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(booking month where slot = s) / max(count(booking month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if taken = slots
  "Fully booked on this day." color good bold

let taken = count(booking where day = d)
topbar booking, "Book court"
row gap 1 align center
  button "<" tap set d = d - 1
  d bold grow align center
  button ">" tap set d = d + 1
goal taken, slots, "slots booked on this day", "slots"
section "Slot grid", "tap a free slot for a quick booking"
  each options booking.court as c
    row gap 1
      c bold width 70
      each options booking.slot as s
        if count(booking where day = d and court = c and slot = s) = 0
          box height 40 radius 6 fill soft grow tap add booking player = "Walk-in", court = c, slot = s, day = d
            s tiny align center
        else
          box height 40 radius 6 fill accent grow
            s tiny align center color bg
row gap 2
  stat sum(booking.fee where day = d), "income this day"
  stat slots - taken, "free slots"
section "Income", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(booking.fee where day = it)
section "Courts", "bookings this month"
  share booking month by court, count(it), it.key
section "Bookings", "this day"
  each booking where day = d sort slot as b empty "Nobody booked yet for this day."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.player bold
        b.court b.slot faint
      b.fee bold
section "Peak hours", "bookings this month"
  each options booking.slot as s
    row gap 2
      s bold grow
      count(booking month where slot = s) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(booking month where slot = s) / max(count(booking month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if taken = slots
  "Fully booked on this day." color good bold

app "Chores" home teal
table chore name text, who pick Ali|Sara|Mama|Baba = Ali, stars num 1..5 = 1
table done chore ref chore

let finished = count(done today)
let all = count(chore)
topbar chore, "Add chore"
statcard finished, "of" all "chores done today", all
row gap 1
  each options chore.who as w
    button w count(chore where who = w) fill if(who_filter = w, accent, soft) tap set who_filter = w
  button "Everyone" fill if(who_filter = All, accent, soft) tap set who_filter = All
each chore where who_filter = All or who = who_filter sort who as c empty "No chores here yet. Add one with Add chore."
  row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
    stack grow gap 0
      c.name bold
      c.who "earns" c.stars "stars" faint
    toggle c.done
section "Stars this week", "who is ahead"
  each options chore.who as w
    row gap 1
      w grow
      sum(done week where chore.who = w, it.chore.stars) "stars" bold
section "Chores finished per day"
  goalbars last 7 days, count(done on it), all
section "Month grid", "darker means more done"
  daygrid last 28 days, count(done on it), max(all, 1)
section "Hardest worker", "this week"
  each options chore.who as w
    stack gap 0
      row
        w grow
        count(done week where chore.who = w) faint
      draw 100, 3
        rect 0, 0, 100, 3 fill soft radius 1
        rect 0, 0, 100 * count(done week where chore.who = w) / max(count(done week), 1), 3 fill accent radius 1

  "Ten stars buys a family movie night." faint
section "Chores per person", "this month"
  each options chore.who as w
    row gap 1

      count(done month where chore.who = w) "done" bold
section "Least done chores", "this month"
  each chore sort count(it.done month) top 3 as c empty "No chores yet."

        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(ride week where platform = p) / max(count(ride week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

  share expense month by kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Add an expense"
  form expense, "Save expense"

app "Kiryana Store" cart slate
table item name text, unit pick Kg|Packet|Dozen|Litre = Packet, cost money, price money, qty num 0.. = 20, low num 0.. = 5
table sale item ref item, qty num 1..100 = 1
setting target money = 3000 "Daily profit goal"
let profit_on(d date) = sum(sale on d, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
let profit = sum(sale today, it.qty * (it.item.price - it.item.cost))
topbar item, "Add item"
statcard profit, "profit today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale today, it.qty * it.item.price), "sales today"
  stat count(sale today), "items sold"
  stat count(item, it.qty <= it.low), "running low"
section "Shelf", "tap Sell for one unit"
  each item sort name as i empty "The shelf is empty. Add your first item with Add item."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)

app "Team Load" users ocean
table person name text, hours num 4..60 = 40 unit "h"
table plan person ref person, task text, hours num 1..40 = 8 unit "h"
setting buffer num = 10 "Keep free (percent)"
let cap = sum(person.hours) * (100 - buffer) / 100
let planned = sum(plan.hours week)
topbar person, "Add person"
goal planned, cap, "hours planned of usable capacity", "h"
row gap 2
  stat round(cap - planned), "usable hours left"
  stat count(person), "people"
  stat count(plan week), "tasks planned"
section "Load per person", "this week"
  each person sort name as p empty "No people yet. Add your team with Add person."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit p swipe remove p
      row
        p.name bold grow
        sum(p.plan.hours week) "of" p.hours "h" faint color if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, muted)
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(p.plan.hours week) / max(p.hours, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, accent) radius 2
section "Hours by person", "planned"
  share person, sum(it.plan.hours week), it.name
section "Planned per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(plan.hours on it)
section "Plan a task"
  form plan, "Save task"
section "Latest tasks"
  list plan top 5, "No tasks planned yet."
section "Who is free", "most hours left first"
  each person sort sum(it.plan.hours week) - it.hours top 3 as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      p.hours - sum(p.plan.hours week) "h free" faint
if planned > cap
  "The team is overloaded this week. Move a task." color bad bold

  each person top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Weekly capacity" faint
      x.hours "h" bold

table plan person ref person, task text, hours num 1..40 = 8 unit "h"
setting buffer num = 10 "Keep free (percent)"
let cap = sum(person.hours) * (100 - buffer) / 100
let planned = sum(plan.hours week)
topbar person, "Add person"
goal planned, cap, "hours planned of usable capacity", "h"
row gap 2
  stat round(cap - planned), "usable hours left"
  stat count(person), "people"
  stat count(plan week), "tasks planned"
section "Load per person", "this week"
  each person sort name as p empty "No people yet. Add your team with Add person."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit p swipe remove p
      row
        p.name bold grow
        sum(p.plan.hours week) "of" p.hours "h" faint color if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, muted)
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(p.plan.hours week) / max(p.hours, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, accent) radius 2
section "Hours by person", "planned"
  share person, sum(it.plan.hours week), it.name
section "Planned per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(plan.hours on it)
section "Plan a task"
  form plan, "Save task"
section "Latest tasks"
  list plan top 5, "No tasks planned yet."
section "Who is free", "most hours left first"
  each person sort sum(it.plan.hours week) - it.hours top 3 as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      p.hours - sum(p.plan.hours week) "h free" faint
if planned > cap
  "The team is overloaded this week. Move a task." color bad bold
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each person top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Weekly capacity" faint
      x.hours "h" bold

program_before:
app "MRR" chart blue dark
table sub customer text, plan pick Starter|Pro|Team = Starter, mrr money, status pick Active|Trial|Churned = Trial
setting target money = 500000 "MRR target"
let live = sum(sub.mrr where status = Active)
screen overview "Overview" chart
  statcard live, "MRR of" target, target
  row gap 2
    stat count(sub where status = Active), "paying customers"
    stat count(sub where status = Trial), "on trial"
    stat count(sub where status = Churned), "churned"
  section "MRR by plan", "active customers"
    share sub where status = Active by plan, sum(it.mrr), it.key
  section "New customers", "last 14 days"
    daybars last 14 days, count(sub on it)
  section "Churn", "share of all customers"
    goal count(sub where status = Churned), max(count(sub), 1), "customers lost", "lost"
  section "Average revenue", "per paying customer"
    stat round(avg(sub.mrr where status = Active)), "ARPU"
screen customers "Customers" users
  topbar sub, "Add customer"
  each sub sort at desc as s empty "No customers yet. Add your first trial."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.customer bold
        s.plan s.mrr faint
      if s.status = Trial
        button "Convert" tap set s.status = Active
      if s.status = Active
        button "Cancel" tap set s.status = Churned
screen team "Targets" target
  goal live, target, "of the MRR target"
  section "Gap", "to the target"
    row gap 2
      stat max(target - live, 0), "MRR still to find"

program_before:
app "Times tables" calc yellow
table attempt q text, right bool
setting level num = 9 "Largest number"
state a num = 6
state b num = 7
state answer num = 0
let right_today = count(attempt today where right = yes)
topbar attempt, "Add by hand"
row gap 2
  statcard right_today, "right today"
  statcard count(attempt today where right = no), "to practise again"
section "Question"
  join(a, " x ", b) huge
  field answer "Your answer"
  row gap 1
    button "Check" fill accent tap add attempt q = join(a, " x ", b), right = if(answer = a * b, yes, no) then set a = random(level) then set b = random(level) then set answer = 0
    button "Skip" tap set a = random(level) then set b = random(level)
section "Right per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, count(attempt on it where right = yes)
section "Accuracy", "last 7 days"
  round(count(attempt last 7 days where right = yes) * 100 / max(count(attempt last 7 days), 1)) "% right" big
  goal count(attempt last 7 days where right = yes), max(count(attempt last 7 days), 1), "right answers", ""
section "Practice days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(attempt on it), 10
section "Questions to repeat"
  each attempt where right = no top 5 as t empty "No wrong answers lately. Great work."
    row gap 2
      t.q grow
      "again" faint
section "Streak"
  streak(attempt) "days of practice" big
section "Attempts"
  list attempt today, "No attempts today. Type an answer and tap Check."
row gap 2
  statcard count(attempt week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(attempt prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(attempt) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(attempt year) faint
  "Last one" since(attempt) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(attempt where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(attempt on it), 2

setting taxp num = 12 "Tax %"

      s2 bold

      s3 bold
    row
      "Fixed charge" grow
      fixed bold
    row
      "Tax" grow
      round(taxes) bold
else
  "Type the units on your meter to see the bill." faint

app "Outer paint" pencil plum
state wide num = 60
state high num = 12
state wins num = 6
state coats num = 2
setting primer money = 650 "Primer per litre"
setting paint money = 1400 "Paint per litre"
setting labour money = 14 "Painter per sq ft"
let area = max(wide * high - wins * 15, 0)
let p_lit = area / 90
let c_lit = area * coats / 80
section "Walls (feet)"
  field wide "Total wall length"
  field high "Height"
  field wins "Windows and doors"
  "Paint coats" coats faint
  slider coats 1..3
if area = 0
  "Enter the wall size." faint
else
  statcard area, "sq ft to paint"
  row gap 2
    stat round(p_lit * 10) / 10, "litres of primer"
    stat round(c_lit * 10) / 10, "litres of paint"
  section "Job cost"
    "Materials" round(p_lit * primer + c_lit * paint) faint
    "Labour" round(area * labour) faint
    "Total" round(p_lit * primer + c_lit * paint + area * labour) big

setting debts money = 0 "Debts to clear"
state mother bool = yes
state sons num = 2
state daughters num = 1
let net = max(sum(asset.value) - debts, 0)
let wife_part = if(mother, net / 8, 0)
let per = (net - wife_part) / max(sons * 2 + daughters, 1)
topbar asset, "Add asset"
statcard net, "estate after debts"
section "Family"
  row gap 2
    toggle mother
    "Wife alive (gets 1/8)" grow
  "Sons" sons faint
  slider sons 0..6
  "Daughters" daughters faint
  slider daughters 0..6
if net > 0 and sons + daughters > 0
  section "Shares"
    if mother
      row
        "Wife" grow
        round(wife_part) bold
    row
      "Each son" grow
      round(per * 2) bold
    row
      "Each daughter" grow
      round(per) bold
list asset top 6, "No assets yet. Add the house, plot, gold and bank money."

program_before:
app "Garden Harvest" plant green
table pick crop pick Tomato|Okra|Spinach|Chilli|Mint|Brinjal = Tomato, grams num 50..20000 = 500 unit "g"
table sow crop text, beds num 1..10 = 1
setting beds_total num = 6 "Beds in the garden"
let used = sum(sow.beds)
topbar pick, "Log harvest"
row gap 2
  stat round(sum(pick.grams month) / 100) / 10, "kg this month"
  stat count(days last 30 days, count(pick on it) > 0), "harvest days of 30"
  stat round(sum(pick.grams today) / 100) / 10, "kg today"
section "Harvest days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(pick on it), 2
section "By crop", "grams this month"
  share pick month by crop, sum(it.grams), it.key
section "Beds", "in use:" used "of" beds_total
  goal used, beds_total, "beds planted", "beds"
  each sow as s empty "Nothing sown yet. Add what is growing below."
    row gap 2
      s.crop bold grow
      s.beds "beds" faint
form sow, "Add planting"
list pick today, "Nothing picked today. Log the first basket."
section "Best picking day", "this month"
  stat max(days month, sum(pick.grams on it)), "g in one day"
section "Kilos per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, round(sum(pick.grams on it) / 100) / 10
section "Streak", "days with a harvest"
  stat streak(pick), "days in a row"
if count(pick today) = 0
  "Nothing picked yet today. Check the tomatoes." faint
section "Kilos per crop", "this month"
  each options pick.crop as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      round(sum(pick.grams month where crop = v) / 100) / 10 "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(round(sum(pick.grams month where crop = v) / 100) / 10 / max(round(sum(pick.grams month) / 100) / 10, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Planted beds"
  goal used, beds_total, "beds in use", "beds"

app "Tank fill" cup slate
state shape pick Round|Box = Round
state wide num = 4
state high num = 5
state long num = 4
state level num = 20
state flow num = 40
state kw num = 0.75
setting rate money = 35 "Price per unit"
let cubic = if(shape = Round, pi * pow(wide / 2, 2) * high, wide * long * high)
let litres = cubic * 28.32
let need = litres * (100 - level) / 100
let mins = need / max(flow, 1)
row gap 1
  choice shape
section "Tank"
  if shape = Round
    field wide "Diameter (ft)"
  else
    field wide "Width (ft)"
    field long "Length (ft)"
  field high "Height (ft)"
  "Full now" level "%" faint
  slider level 0..100
  field flow "Pump flow (litres a minute)"
statcard round(litres), "litres when full"
if level >= 100
  "The tank is already full." big color good
else
  "Time to fill" floor(mins / 60) "h" round(mins % 60) "min" big
  "Water to add" round(need) "litres" faint
  "Pump power cost" round(mins / 60 * kw * rate) faint

app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)

row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1

  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"

"Last 10 weeks" head

    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)

form habit

app "Habits" check mint

      row gap 1
        each days last 7 days

            dayname(it) tiny color muted
            box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
section "Numbers"

    stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"

program_before:
app "Bank Compare" money slate
state loan money = 0
state years num = 5
state ra num = 15
state fa num = 1
state rb num = 13.5
state fb num = 2.5
let n = years * 12
let emi(r num) = if(r = 0, loan / n, loan * r / 1200 * pow(1 + r / 1200, n) / (pow(1 + r / 1200, n) - 1))
let ta = emi(ra) * n + loan * fa / 100
let tb = emi(rb) * n + loan * fb / 100
row gap 2
  field loan "Loan"
  field years "Years"
section "Bank A"
  row gap 2
    field ra "Rate %"
    field fa "Fee %"
section "Bank B"
  row gap 2
    field rb "Rate %"
    field fb "Fee %"
if loan > 0
  statcard round(abs(ta - tb)), if(ta <= tb, "cheaper at Bank A", "cheaper at Bank B")
  row gap 2
    stat round(emi(ra)), "Bank A per month"
    stat round(emi(rb)), "Bank B per month"
else
  "Type the loan amount to compare the banks." faint

table member name text
table loan member ref member, amount money, purpose pick Seeds|Fertiliser|Tools|Animals|Other = Seeds, due date

        l.purpose "- due" l.due faint color if(l.due < today, bad, muted)

        l.amount - sum(l.repay.amount) bold
        "balance" tiny faint
      button "Repay" tap add repay loan = l, amount = step
section "Give a loan"

  each member sort name as m
    row gap 2
      m.name bold grow
      sum(m.loan.amount) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(m.loan.amount) / max(sum(loan.amount), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

program_before:
app "Knitting" star pink
table project name text, yarn text?, target num 10..5000 = 200 unit "rows", status pick Active|Paused|Finished = Active
table rowlog project ref project, rows num 1..200 = 10
let active = count(project where status = Active)
topbar project, "New project"
row gap 2
  statcard active, "projects in progress"
  statcard sum(rowlog.rows today), "rows knitted today"
  statcard sum(rowlog.rows week), "rows this week"
each project where status != Finished sort name as p empty "No projects yet. Cast on your first scarf and add it."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        p.name bold
        p.yarn faint
      sum(p.rowlog.rows) "of" p.target faint
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(p.rowlog.rows) / p.target, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
    row gap 1
      button "+10 rows" tap add rowlog project = p, rows = 10
      button "+25 rows" tap add rowlog project = p, rows = 25
      button "Finish" tap set p.status = Finished
section "Rows per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(rowlog.rows on it)
section "Craft days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(rowlog on it), 2
section "Finished", "projects:" count(project where status = Finished)
  each project where status = Finished as p empty "Nothing finished yet. Your first one is close."
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      sum(p.rowlog.rows) "rows" faint
section "Streak"
  streak(rowlog) "days of knitting" big
row gap 2
  statcard count(rowlog week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(rowlog prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(rowlog) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(rowlog year) faint
  "Last one" since(rowlog) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(rowlog where dayname(at) = it), it

program_before:
app "Language" book orange
table practice mins num 5..240 unit "min", skill pick Listening|Speaking|Reading|Writing|Words = Words, newwords num? 0..100
setting daily_mins num = 20 "Daily minutes"
let today_mins = sum(practice.mins today)
topbar practice, "Log practice"
statcard today_mins, "min today, goal" daily_mins, daily_mins
row gap 2
  statcard sum(practice.newwords), "new words learned"
  statcard streak(practice), "day streak"
section "Minutes per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(practice.mins on it), daily_mins
section "Skills", "last 30 days"
  share practice last 30 days by skill, sum(it.mins), it.key
section "Words per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, sum(practice.newwords week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Calendar", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, sum(practice.mins on it), daily_mins
section "Goal days", "last 30 days"
  count(days last 30 days, sum(practice.mins on it) >= daily_mins) big
  "days you met your daily goal" faint
section "Sessions"
  list practice by day, "No practice yet. Ten minutes a day beats two hours on Sunday."
row gap 2
  statcard count(practice week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(practice prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(practice) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(practice year) faint
  "Last one" since(practice) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(practice where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(practice on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(practice.mins) * 10) / 10 "min" big
  "Highest" max(practice.mins) "min" faint
  "Lowest" min(practice.mins) "min" faint

program_before:
app "Zakat check" coin ocean
table paid amount money, note text?
state cash money = 0
state bank money = 0
state gold num = 0
state owed money = 0

state basis pick Silver|Gold = Silver
let wealth = cash + bank + gold * gold_rate - owed

if nisab = 0
  "Type today's gold or silver rate to see the nisab." faint
else
  statcard round(due), if(wealth >= nisab, "zakat due at 2.5%", "below nisab, no zakat due")
  goal max(wealth, 0), nisab, "net wealth against nisab"
  button "Mark as paid" tap add paid amount = round(due), note = "Zakat"
section "Paid so far", sum(paid.amount)

app "School Fees" school red
table student name text, class pick Class_1|Class_2|Class_3|Class_4|Class_5 = Class_1
table payment student ref student, amount money = 1500
setting monthly money = 1500 "Monthly fee"
let expected = count(student) * monthly
let paid = count(student, count(it.payment month) > 0)
screen collect "Collect" money
  statcard sum(payment.amount month), "collected of" expected, expected
  row gap 2
    stat paid, "paid"
    stat count(student) - paid, "still to pay"
    stat round(paid * 100 / max(count(student), 1)), "percent paid"
  section "Not paid yet", "tap Paid when the fee arrives"
    each student sort name as s empty "No students yet. Add them on the Students tab."
      if count(s.payment month) = 0
        row card gap 2
          stack grow gap 0
            s.name bold
            s.class faint
          button "Paid" tap add payment student = s, amount = monthly
screen people "Students" users
  topbar student, "Add student"
  each student sort name as s empty "No students yet. Tap Add student."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.payment month
      s.name bold grow
      s.class faint
  section "By class"
    share student by class, count(it), it.key
screen reports "Reports" chart
  section "Fees per month", "last 6 months"
    bars days last 6 months, sum(payment.amount month of it), monthname(it)
  section "Paid per class", "this month"
    share payment month by student.class, count(it), it.key
  section "Latest payments"
    list payment top 5, "No payments yet."

program_before:
app "Velocity" bolt mint
table story title text, points num 1..13 = 3, dev pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali
table finished story ref story
setting commit num = 40 "Sprint commitment (points)"
let done_pts = sum(finished, it.story.points)
topbar story, "Add story"
goal done_pts, commit, "points finished this sprint", "pts"
row gap 2
  stat count(finished), "stories done"
  stat count(story) - count(finished), "stories left"
  stat sum(story.points) - done_pts, "points left"
section "Stories", "tick when done"
  each story sort at as s empty "No stories yet. Add the first one with Add story."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.finished all
      stack grow gap 0
        s.title bold
        s.dev faint
      s.points "pts" bold
section "Points done per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(finished on it, it.story.points)
section "Points per developer", "finished"
  share finished by story.dev, sum(it, it.story.points), it.key
section "Load per developer"
  each options story.dev as d
    row gap 2
      d bold grow
      sum(story.points where dev = d) "pts" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(story.points where dev = d) / max(sum(story.points), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Working days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(finished on it), 3
section "Biggest stories left", "top 3"
  each story sort points desc top 3 as s
    row gap 2
      s.title bold grow
      s.points "pts" faint
if done_pts >= commit
  "Commitment met." color good bold

app "Academy Fees" school blue
table student name text, class pick Grade_6|Grade_7|Grade_8|Matric = Grade_6
table fee student ref student, amount money = 3500
setting capacity num = 40 "Seats in the academy"
let paid = count(student, count(it.fee month) > 0)
topbar student, "Add student"
statcard sum(fee.amount month), "collected this month from" paid "of" count(student), count(student) * 3500
goal count(student), capacity, "seats filled", "students"
section "Not paid yet", "this month"
  if paid = count(student) and paid > 0
    "Everyone has paid this month. Well done." color good bold
  each student sort name as s empty "No students yet. Add the first name with Add student."
    if count(s.fee month) = 0
      row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
        toggle s.fee month
        stack grow gap 0
          s.name bold
          s.class faint
        "Due" color bad
section "Students per class"
  share student by class, count(it), it.key
section "Fees collected", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(fee.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Paid this month", count(fee month)
  list fee month, "No fees paid yet this month."
section "Fee collection", "this month"
  goal paid, max(count(student), 1), "students have paid"
section "New students", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, count(student month of it), monthname(it)
section "Class sizes"
  row gap 2
    each options student.class as c
      stat count(student where class = c), c
if count(student) >= capacity
  "The academy is full." color warn bold
section "Paid per class", "this month"
  each options student.class as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(student where class = v and count(fee month) > 0) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(student where class = v and count(fee month) > 0) / max(count(student where class = v), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Bug Board" tool purple dark
table bug title text, severity pick Low|Medium|High|Critical = Medium, status pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open, hours num 1..40 = 2 unit "h"

state tab pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open

goal sum(bug.hours where status = Done), budget, "hours fixed this sprint", "h"
row gap 1
  each options bug.status as s
    button s count(bug where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s

  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow gap 0
      b.title bold
      b.severity "-" b.hours "h" faint color if(b.severity = Critical, bad, muted)

      button "Start" tap set b.status = Fixing
    if b.status = Fixing
      button "Done" tap set b.status = Done
section "By severity", "all bugs"
  share bug by severity, count(it), it.key
section "Bugs reported per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(bug on it)

    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Fixing), "h in progress"

if sum(bug.hours where status != Done) > budget
  "Open work is more than the sprint budget. Cut scope." color warn bold

  each options bug.severity as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(bug.hours where severity = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(bug.hours where severity = v) / max(sum(bug.hours), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Longest open bug"
  each bug where status != Done sort hours desc top 1 as b empty "No open bugs."
    row card gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.hours "h" bold

program_before:
app "Volunteers" heart green
table shift volunteer text, task pick Kitchen|Delivery|Packing|Front_desk = Kitchen, hours num 1..12 = 3 unit "h"
setting goal num = 200 "Volunteer hours goal this month"
topbar shift, "Log shift"
goal sum(shift.hours month), goal, "volunteer hours this month", "h"
row gap 2
  stat count(shift month), "shifts"
  stat sum(shift.hours today), "hours today"
  stat round(avg(shift.hours month) * 10) / 10, "hours per shift"
section "Hours per task", "this month"
  share shift month by task, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Top volunteers", "hours this month"
  bars shift month by volunteer, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Days covered", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(shift on it), 3
section "This week"
  weekdots count(shift on it) > 0
section "Hours per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(shift.hours on it), goal / 30
section "Latest shifts"
  each shift top 5 as s empty "No shifts logged yet. Log the first one after today's session."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.volunteer bold
        s.task faint
      s.hours "h" bold
section "Hours per task", "this week"
  each options shift.task as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(shift.hours week where task = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(shift.hours week where task = v) / max(sum(shift.hours week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if sum(shift.hours month) >= goal
  "Monthly goal reached. Thank the team." color good bold
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each shift top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.volunteer bold
        x.task faint
      x.hours "h" bold

table shift volunteer text, task pick Kitchen|Delivery|Packing|Front_desk = Kitchen, hours num 1..12 = 3 unit "h"
setting goal num = 200 "Volunteer hours goal this month"
topbar shift, "Log shift"
goal sum(shift.hours month), goal, "volunteer hours this month", "h"
row gap 2
  stat count(shift month), "shifts"
  stat sum(shift.hours today), "hours today"
  stat round(avg(shift.hours month) * 10) / 10, "hours per shift"
section "Hours per task", "this month"
  share shift month by task, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Top volunteers", "hours this month"
  bars shift month by volunteer, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "My days covered", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(shift on it), 3
section "This week"
  weekdots count(shift on it) > 0
section "Hours per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(shift.hours on it), goal / 30
section "Latest shifts"
  each shift top 5 as s empty "No shifts logged yet. Log the first one after today's session."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.volunteer bold
        s.task faint
      s.hours "h" bold
section "Hours per task", "this week"
  each options shift.task as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(shift.hours week where task = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(shift.hours week where task = v) / max(sum(shift.hours week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if sum(shift.hours month) >= goal
  "Monthly goal reached. Thank the team." color good bold
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each shift top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.volunteer bold
        x.task faint
      x.hours "h" bold

      w.title bold grow
      w.due faint
section "Later or no date"
  each item where done = no and not (due <= today + 7) sort due as l empty "Nothing waiting."
    row gap 2 tap edit l swipe remove l
      toggle l.done

      l.due faint

program_before:
app "Hifz" book green
table session surah text, ayahs num 1..300 unit "ayahs", kind pick New|Revision = New, mins num? 1..240
setting daily_ayahs num = 5 "New ayahs per day"
let new_today = sum(session.ayahs today where kind = New)
let total_new = sum(session.ayahs where kind = New)
topbar session, "Log session"
statcard new_today, "new ayahs today, goal" daily_ayahs, daily_ayahs
row gap 2
  statcard streak(session), "day streak"
  statcard total_new, "ayahs memorised in all"
section "New ayahs per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(session.ayahs on it where kind = New), daily_ayahs
section "Revision", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(session.ayahs on it where kind = Revision)
section "New or revision", "this month"
  share session month by kind, sum(it.ayahs), it.key
section "Time spent", "minutes this week"
  sum(session.mins week) "min" big
  "Average per session" round(avg(session.mins week)) "min" faint
section "Practice days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(session on it), 2
section "Sessions"
  each session by day as g empty "No sessions yet. After you memorise or revise, log it here."
    row
      g.key bold grow
      sum(g.ayahs) "ayahs" faint
    each g as r
      row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
        r.surah r.kind grow
        r.ayahs bold
section "Goal days", "last 30 days"
  count(days last 30 days, sum(session.ayahs on it where kind = New) >= daily_ayahs) big
  "days you reached your new ayah goal" faint
section "Surahs worked on"
  share session last 30 days by surah, sum(it.ayahs), it.key
section "Best day", "all time"
  max(days last 90 days, sum(session.ayahs on it)) "ayahs" big
  "Sessions this month" count(session month) faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(session week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(session prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(session) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(session year) faint
  "Last one" since(session) "days ago" faint

table deed name text, when_ pick Morning|Day|Evening|Night = Morning
table did deed ref deed
let n = count(deed)
let finished = count(did today)
topbar deed, "Add a deed"
statcard finished, "of" n "deeds done today", n
if finished = n and n > 0
  "All deeds done today. May Allah accept." head
each deed sort when_ as d empty "No deeds yet. Add morning adhkar, duha prayer, reading a page of Quran."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        d.name bold
        d.when_ faint
        streak(d.did) "day streak, best" best(d.did) faint
      toggle d.did
    weekdots count(d.did on it) > 0
section "Last 6 weeks", "average" round(count(did last 42 days) * 100 / max(n * 42, 1)) "%"
  daygrid last 42 days, count(did on it), max(n, 1)
section "Deeds done per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, count(did on it), max(n, 1)
section "By time of day", "this month"
  each options deed.when_ as w
    row gap 1
      w grow
      count(did month where deed.when_ = w) bold
section "Most consistent", "this month"
  each deed sort count(it.did month) desc top 3 as d empty "Add deeds to see this."
    row gap 2
      d.name grow
      count(d.did month) "days" bold
section "Needs love", "least done this month"
  each deed sort count(it.did month) top 2 as d empty "Add deeds to see this."
    row gap 2
      d.name grow
      count(d.did month) "days" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(did week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(did prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(did) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(did year) faint
  "Last one" since(did) "days ago" faint

app "Baby days" baby blue
table diaper kind pick Wet|Dirty|Both = Wet
table milestone what text, day date = today
setting born date = 2026-06-01 "Baby's birthday"
let months_old = floor((today - born) / 30)
topbar milestone, "Add milestone"
row gap 2
  statcard months_old, "months old"
  statcard count(diaper today), "diapers today"
section "Diapers", "tap to log one"
  row gap 1
    each options diaper.kind as k
      button k count(diaper today where kind = k) tap add diaper kind = k
  daybars last 7 days, count(diaper on it)
section "Wet or dirty", "last 7 days"
  share diaper last 7 days by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Diaper days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(diaper on it), 8
section "Firsts"
  each milestone sort day desc as m empty "No milestones yet. Add the first smile, the first roll."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.what bold
        m.day faint
      "at" floor((m.day - born) / 7) "weeks" faint
section "Average a day", "last 7 days"
  round(count(diaper last 7 days) / 7) big
  "diapers a day, enough wet ones mean enough milk" faint
section "Milestones count"
  count(milestone) big
row gap 2
  statcard count(diaper week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(diaper prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(diaper) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(diaper year) faint
  "Last one" since(diaper) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(diaper where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(diaper on it), 2

Current program:
app "Laundry" cup blue
table order cust text, pieces num 1..100, stage pick Picked|Ready|Delivered = Picked, paid bool
setting rate money = 60 "Charge per piece"
screen pickups "Pickups" home
  topbar order, "New pickup"
  each order where stage = Picked sort at as o empty "No clothes waiting to be washed."
    row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
      stack grow gap 0
        o.cust bold
        o.pieces "pieces" faint
      button "Ready" tap set o.stage = Ready
screen ready "Ready" check
  each order where stage = Ready sort at as o empty "Nothing ready to deliver."
    row card gap 2 tap edit o
      stack grow gap 0
        o.cust bold
        o.pieces * rate faint
      button "Delivered" tap set o.stage = Delivered
screen money "Money" money
  statcard sum(order, if(it.stage = Delivered and not it.paid, it.pieces * rate, 0)), "to collect from customers"
  each order where stage = Delivered and paid = no sort at as o empty "Everyone has paid."
    row card gap 2
      toggle o.paid
      o.cust bold grow
      o.pieces * rate bold

program_before:
app "Quiz night" trophy ink
table point team pick Table_1|Table_2, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Table_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Table_2)
setting winat num = 30 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Table 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Table_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Table_1, pts = 5
  stack card grow align center
    "Table 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Table_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Table_2, pts = 5
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Table 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Table 2 win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point

    toggle r.hearts

section "Family favourites"
  each recipe where hearts = yes sort name as r empty "Tap the heart on a recipe to make it a favourite."
    row gap 2
      icon heart
      r.name grow
section "Cooked per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(cooked week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)

  each recipe sort count(it.cooked all) desc top 3 as r empty "Cook something to see this."
    row gap 2
      r.name grow
      count(r.cooked all) "times" bold

  count(recipe where mins <= 30) big
row gap 2
  statcard count(cooked week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(cooked prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(cooked) "entries so far" big

state d2 num = 1

  row gap 1

  row gap 2

        d2 huge align center
    if dice >= 3
      box width 72 height 72 radius 14 fill soft
        d3 huge align center
  "Total" d1 + if(dice >= 2, d2, 0) + if(dice >= 3, d3, 0) big
  button "Roll" fill accent tap set d1 = random(6) then set d2 = random(6) then set d3 = random(6)
screen quiz "Trivia" brain
  topbar trivia, "Add question"
  if count(trivia) = 0
    "Add a few questions, then draw one while you wait." faint
  else
    stack card gap 2
      qa.question head
      if show
        qa.answer big color good
      button if(show, "Hide answer", "Show answer") tap set show = not show
    button "Another question" fill accent tap set n = random(count(trivia)) then set show = no

program_before:
app "Tractor Hire" bus green
table hire farmer text, work pick Ploughing|Seeding|Harvesting|Hauling = Ploughing, hours num 1..24 = 4 unit "h", rate money = 1800, paid bool
setting target num = 80 "Hours a week I want to run"
let owed = sum(hire where paid = no, it.hours * it.rate)
topbar hire, "Log hire"
statcard owed, "still owed by" count(hire where paid = no) "farmers"
goal sum(hire.hours week), target, "hours run this week", "h"
section "Unpaid", "tick when the farmer pays"
  each hire where paid = no sort at as h empty "Nobody owes you. All hires are paid."
    row card gap 2 tap edit h swipe remove h
      toggle h.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        h.farmer bold
        h.work "-" h.hours "h at" h.rate faint
      h.hours * h.rate bold
section "Hours by work", "this month"
  share hire month by work, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Earnings per week", "last 6 weeks"
  bars days last 6 weeks, sum(hire week of it, it.hours * it.rate), monthday(it)
section "Busiest days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, sum(hire.hours on it), 8
section "Best farmers", "hours this year"
  bars hire year by farmer, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "This month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(hire month, it.hours * it.rate), "earned"
    stat sum(hire.hours month), "hours"
    stat count(hire month), "hires"
section "Hours per work type", "this month"
  each options hire.work as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(hire.hours month where work = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(hire.hours month where work = v) / max(sum(hire.hours month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each hire top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.farmer bold
        x.work faint
      x.hours "h" bold

program_before:
app "Helpdesk" phone mint
table ticket subject text, channel pick Email|Chat|Phone|Social = Email, priority pick Low|Normal|Urgent = Normal, status pick New|Working|Solved = New, mins num 1..600 = 15 unit "min"
setting sla num = 30 "Handling target (min)"
state tab pick New|Working|Solved = New
topbar ticket, "Log ticket"
row gap 2
  stat count(ticket where status != Solved), "open"
  stat count(ticket where priority = Urgent and status != Solved), "urgent"
  stat count(ticket today where status = Solved), "solved today"
statcard round(avg(ticket.mins week)), "average minutes, target" sla, sla
row gap 1
  each options ticket.status as s
    button s count(ticket where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each ticket where status = tab sort priority desc as t empty "Nothing in this list."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.subject bold
      t.channel "-" t.mins "min" faint color if(t.mins > sla, warn, muted)
    if t.priority = Urgent
      "Urgent" color bad bold
    if t.status = New
      button "Take" tap set t.status = Working
    if t.status = Working
      button "Solve" tap set t.status = Solved
section "By channel", "this week"
  share ticket week by channel, count(it), it.key
section "Tickets per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(ticket on it)
section "Handling time", "last 14 days"
  trend ticket last 14 days sort at, it.mins
section "Tickets per priority", "still open"
  each options ticket.priority as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(ticket where priority = v and status != Solved) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(ticket where priority = v and status != Solved) / max(count(ticket where status != Solved), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(ticket where status != Solved) > 20
  "The queue is long. Ask for help." color warn bold

app "Calc" calc slate dark
state acc num = 0
state cur num = 0
state op pick Add|Sub|Mul|Div|Nop = Nop

      count(did month where step.slot = s) bold

    row gap 2

      s.slot faint

  "Sunscreen every morning does more than any cream at night." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(did week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(did prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(did) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(did year) faint
  "Last one" since(did) "days ago" faint

program_before:
app "Blood pressure" heart red
table reading sys num 70..250 unit "mmHg", dia num 40..150 unit "mmHg", pulse num? 30..200, moment pick Morning|Evening|Other = Morning
setting limit_sys num = 130 "Upper limit (systolic)"
setting limit_dia num = 85 "Upper limit (diastolic)"
let high = count(reading month where sys > limit_sys or dia > limit_dia)
let n = count(reading month)
remind "Measure your blood pressure" at 8:00, 20:00
topbar reading, "Add reading"
row card gap 3 align center
  stack grow gap 0
    "Latest reading" faint
    join(last(reading.sys), "/", last(reading.dia)) huge
    if(last(reading.sys) > limit_sys or last(reading.dia) > limit_dia, "Above your limit. Rest and measure again.", "Inside your limits") faint
    "Pulse" last(reading.pulse) faint
  icon heart
section "Systolic trend", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.sys
  "Your limit is" limit_sys faint
section "Diastolic trend", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.dia
row gap 2
  statcard round(avg(reading.sys month)), "average systolic this month"
  statcard round(avg(reading.dia month)), "average diastolic this month"
  statcard high, "high readings of" n "this month", n
section "Morning or evening", "average systolic"
  each options reading.moment as m
    row gap 1
      m grow
      round(avg(reading.sys where moment = m)) bold
      "from" count(reading where moment = m) "readings" faint
section "Readings per week"
  daybars last 14 days, count(reading on it)
section "Highest reading", "this month"
  max(reading.sys month) "/" max(reading.dia month) big
  "Lowest" min(reading.sys month) "/" min(reading.dia month) faint
section "History"
  list reading by day, "No readings yet. Measure sitting down, after five minutes of rest."
section "Pulse", "when recorded"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.pulse
  "Average pulse" round(avg(reading.pulse month)) faint
section "In range", "this month"
  goal n - high, max(n, 1), "readings inside your limits", ""
section "Notes for the doctor"
  "Highest this year" max(reading.sys year) "/" max(reading.dia year) bold
  "Readings this year" count(reading year) faint
  "Show this screen at your next visit." faint

  form guest, "Add guest"

          g.name small
screen gifts "Gifts" gift
  form gift, "Add gift"
  list gift
screen notes "Thank you" note
  each guest where rsvp = Yes as g
    row card
      toggle g.thanks
      g.name grow
  form thanks, "Add thank-you note"

    share trip month by kind, sum(it.fare), it.key
  section "Fuel stops"
    list fuel top 8, "No fuel bought yet. Add your next fill-up."
screen summary "Summary" chart
  section "This week", "earnings"
    daybars week, sum(trip.fare on it)

    stat sum(trip.fare week), "earned"
    stat sum(fuel.cost week), "fuel"
    stat sum(trip.fare week) - sum(fuel.cost week), "kept"
  section "Trips by kind"
    share trip week by kind, count(it), it.key
screen log "Quick add" plus

  form fuel, "Save fuel"
