program_before:
app "Car care" tool slate dark
table job kind pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Battery|Filter|Other = Oil, at_km num 0..999999 unit "km", cost money, note text?
setting odo num = 85000 "Odometer now (km)"
setting oil_every num = 5000 "Oil change every (km)"
let oil_due = last(job.at_km where kind = Oil) + oil_every
topbar job, "Log job"
row gap 2
  statcard odo, "km on the clock"
  statcard max(oil_due - odo, 0), "km until the next oil change"
section "Oil change", "progress to the next one"
  goal clamp(odo - last(job.at_km where kind = Oil), 0, oil_every), oil_every, "km since the last oil change", "km"
section "Last done", "by job"
  each options job.kind as k
    row gap 1
      k grow
      if(count(job where kind = k) > 0, join(odo - last(job.at_km where kind = k), " km ago"), "never") faint
section "Spend by job", "all time"
  share job by kind, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(job.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Total spent"
  sum(job.cost year) big
  "this year, over" count(job year) "jobs" faint
section "Service history"
  list job by day, "No jobs logged yet. Add your last oil change to start."
row gap 2
  statcard count(job week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(job prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(job) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(job year) faint
  "Last one" since(job) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(job where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(job on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(job.at_km) * 10) / 10 "km" big
  "Highest" max(job.at_km) "km" faint
  "Lowest" min(job.at_km) "km" faint

app "Car Cost" car ocean dark
state fuel money = 0
state service money = 0
state insure money = 0
state loss money = 0
state km num = 12000
let total = fuel + service + insure + loss
row gap 2
  field fuel "Petrol per year"
  field service "Servicing and repairs"
row gap 2
  field insure "Insurance and tax"
  field loss "Value loss per year"
field km "Kilometres per year"
if total > 0 and km > 0
  statcard round(total / km * 100) / 100, "per kilometre"
  row gap 2
    stat round(total / 12), "per month"
    stat round(total), "per year"
  draw 100, 6
    rect 0, 0, 100 * fuel / total, 6 fill accent
    rect 100 * fuel / total, 0, 100 * service / total, 6 fill warn
    rect 100 * (fuel + service) / total, 0, 100 * insure / total, 6 fill muted
else
  "Fill in the yearly costs to see the price per km." faint

state fuel money = 0
state service money = 0
state insure money = 0
state loss money = 0
state km num = 12000
let total = fuel + service + insure + loss
row gap 2
  field fuel "Petrol per year"
  field service "Servicing and repairs"
row gap 2
  field insure "Insurance and tax"
  field loss "Value loss per year"
field km "Kilometres per year"
if total > 0 and km > 0
  statcard round(total / km * 100) / 100, "per kilometre"
  row gap 2
    stat round(total / 12), "per month"
  draw 100, 6
    rect 0, 0, 100 * fuel / total, 6 fill accent
    rect 100 * fuel / total, 0, 100 * service / total, 6 fill warn
    rect 100 * (fuel + service) / total, 0, 100 * insure / total, 6 fill muted
else
  "Fill in the yearly costs to see the price per km." faint

app "Growth" baby blue
table growth cm num 30..200 unit "cm", kg num 2..120 unit "kg", note text?
setting target_cm num = 110 "Height by next birthday (cm)"
let h = last(growth.cm)
let w = last(growth.kg)
let first_cm = first(growth.cm)
topbar growth, "Measure"
row gap 2
  statcard h, "cm tall now"
  statcard w, "kg now"
statcard h - first_cm, "cm grown since the first entry"
section "Height", "all entries"
  trend growth, it.cm
section "Weight", "all entries"
  trend growth, it.kg
section "Goal height", "now" h "of" target_cm "cm"
  goal h, target_cm, "centimetres toward the goal", "cm"
  "Still to grow" max(target_cm - h, 0) "cm" faint
section "Growth per month", "cm gained"
  bars 1..6, max(max(growth.cm month of addmonths(today, it - 6)) - min(growth.cm month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), 0), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Body mass index", "rough guide only"
  round(w * 10000 / max(h * h, 1) * 10) / 10 big
  "Ask your doctor to read this, not a chart on a phone." faint
section "Measurements"
  list growth, "No measurements yet. Measure against a wall and tap Measure."
section "Last three", "recent measurements"
  each growth top 3 as g empty "No measurements yet."
    row gap 2
      g.at grow
      g.cm "cm" bold
      g.kg "kg" faint
section "Weeks since measuring", "keep it monthly"
  since(growth) big
  "days since the last measurement" faint
section "Notes"
  each growth where note != "" top 3 as g empty "No notes."
    g.note faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(growth week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(growth prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(growth) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(growth year) faint
  "Last one" since(growth) "days ago" faint

program_before:
app "Tank Levels" drop teal
table level tank pick Roof|Ground = Roof, pct num 0..100
state tk text = Roof
let roof = if(count(level where tank = Roof) = 0, 0, last(level.pct where tank = Roof))
let ground = if(count(level where tank = Ground) = 0, 0, last(level.pct where tank = Ground))
draw 100, 60
  rect 5, 5, 35, 50 stroke ink thick 1 radius 3
  rect 6, 55 - 48 * roof / 100, 33, 48 * roof / 100 fill accent
  label 22, 32, roof "%" bold
  rect 60, 5, 35, 50 stroke ink thick 1 radius 3
  rect 61, 55 - 48 * ground / 100, 33, 48 * ground / 100 fill accent
  label 78, 32, ground "%" bold
row gap 2
  "Roof tank" align center grow
  "Ground tank" align center grow
if roof < 25 or ground < 25
  "A tank is under 25 percent. Run the motor." color bad
row gap 1
  each options level.tank
    button it fill if(tk = it, accent, soft) grow tap set tk = it
row gap 1
  each [25, 50, 75, 100]
    button it "%" grow tap add level tank = tk, pct = it
each level sort at desc top 8 as l empty "No levels logged yet."
  row gap 2 swipe remove l
    l.tank grow
    l.pct "%" bold
    l.at faint

program_before:
app "Boutique" tag purple
table dress name text, size pick S|M|L|XL = M, qty num 0.. = 5, price money, cost money
table sale dress ref dress, price money
setting low num = 2 "Low stock at"
let profit = sum(sale, it.price - it.dress.cost)
topbar dress, "Add dress"
statcard profit, "profit from" count(sale) "sales"
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale.price today), "sold today"
  stat sum(dress, it.qty * it.cost), "money in stock"
  stat count(dress where qty <= low), "need restocking"
section "Dresses", "tap Sell when one goes out"
  each dress sort name as d empty "No dresses yet. Add your first design with Add dress."
    row card gap 2 tap edit d swipe remove d
      stack grow gap 0
        d.name bold color if(d.qty <= low, warn, ink)
        d.size "-" d.price faint
      d.qty bold
      button "Sell" tap set d.qty = d.qty - 1 then add sale dress = d, price = d.price
section "Sales", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(sale.price on it)
section "Profit by size"
  share sale by dress.size, sum(it, it.price - it.dress.cost), it.key
section "Best sellers", "number sold"
  bars dress sort count(it.sale) desc top 5, count(it.sale), it.name
section "Restock", "at or below the low level"
  each dress where qty <= low as d empty "Nothing to restock."
    row gap 2
      d.name d.size bold grow
      d.qty "left" faint color warn
section "Stock per size", "pieces on the rack"
  each options dress.size as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(dress.qty where size = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(dress.qty where size = v) / max(sum(dress.qty), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each dress top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.size faint
      x.qty bold

table gift donor text?, amount money, fund pick Building|Zakat|Iftar|Salaries = Building
setting target money = 2000000 "Building fund target"

topbar gift, "Add donation"
statcard building, "raised for the building of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(gift.amount today), "received today"
  stat sum(gift.amount month), "this month"
  stat count(gift month), "donations this month"
section "By fund", "all time"
  share gift by fund, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Donations per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(gift.amount on it)
section "Biggest gifts", "top 3"
  each gift sort amount desc top 3 as g empty "No donations yet. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit g swipe remove g
      stack grow gap 0
        g.donor bold
        g.fund faint
      g.amount bold
list gift by day, "No donations recorded yet."
section "Zakat and Iftar", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(gift.amount month where fund = Zakat), "Zakat"
    stat sum(gift.amount month where fund = Iftar), "Iftar"
    stat sum(gift.amount month where fund = Salaries), "Salaries"
section "Still needed", "for the building"
  goal building, target, "raised so far"
  stat target - building, "still to raise"
section "Average gift", "this month"
  stat round(avg(gift.amount month)), "per donation"
section "Share of all gifts", "by fund"
  each options gift.fund as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(gift.amount where fund = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(gift.amount where fund = v) / max(sum(gift.amount), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

table gift total money was amount, cause pick Mosque|Family|Orphans|Neighbours|Food = Family, note text?
setting monthly_goal money = 5000 "Monthly giving goal"
state cause_filter text = ""
let given = sum(gift.total month)
let this_year = sum(gift.total year)
topbar gift, "Add gift"
statcard given, "given this month, goal" monthly_goal, monthly_goal
row gap 2
  stat this_year, "given this year"
  stat count(gift year), "gifts this year"
  stat round(avg(gift.total year)), "average gift"
section "By cause", "this year"
  share gift year by cause, sum(it.total), it.key
section "Gifts per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(gift.total on it)
section "Giving streak", "days in a row"
  streak(gift) big
  "Best run" best(gift) "days" faint
quick gift, total, [100, 500, 1000]
section "Filter by cause"
  row gap 1
    each options gift.cause as c
      button c fill if(cause_filter = c, accent, soft) tap set cause_filter = if(cause_filter = c, "", c)
  each gift where cause_filter = "" or cause = cause_filter as g empty "No gifts here yet. Even a small gift counts."
    row card gap 2 tap edit g swipe remove g
      stack grow gap 0
        g.cause bold
        g.note faint
      g.total bold
section "Biggest gift", "this year"
  max(gift.total year) big
  "Last gift" last(gift.total) faint
section "Months of giving", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(gift.total month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Reminder"
  "Give a little every day. The most loved deeds are small and steady." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(gift week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(gift prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(gift) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(gift year) faint
  "Last one" since(gift) "days ago" faint

app "Rent or Buy" home teal
state price money = 9000000
state down money = 2000000
state rate num = 15
state years num = 8
state rent money = 60000
state rise num = 8
state grow num = 6
let r = rate / 1200
let n = years * 12
let pay = if(r > 0, (price - down) * r / (1 - pow(1 + r, 0 - (25 * 12))), (price - down) / 300)
let paid_loan = pay * n
let owed = (price - down) * pow(1 + r, n) - pay * (pow(1 + r, n) - 1) / max(r, 0.0001)
let value = price * pow(1 + grow / 100, years)
let buy_net = down + paid_loan + owed - value
let rent_total = if(rise > 0, rent * 12 * (pow(1 + rise / 100, years) - 1) / (rise / 100), rent * 12 * years)
section "The flat (25 year loan)"
  field price "Flat price"
  field down "Down payment"
  field rate "Interest % a year"
  field grow "Price growth % a year"
section "Renting"
  field rent "Rent now (monthly)"
  field rise "Rent rise % a year"
"Years I will stay" years faint
slider years 1..25
row gap 2
  statcard round(rent_total), "rent paid over" years "years"
  statcard round(buy_net), "buying, net cost"
"Better:" if(rent_total <= buy_net, "Rent", "Buy") big

program_before:
app "Habits Buddy" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

app "Masala Mixer" leaf red
table blend name text, grams num

program_before:
app "Guest House" home ocean
table room name text, rate money
table stay room ref room, guest text, nights num 1..30 = 1, checkin date = today, paid bool
setting target num = 70 "Occupancy target (percent)"
let occupied(r room) = count(stay where room = r and checkin <= today and checkin + nights > today)
let busy = count(room, occupied(it) > 0)
topbar room, "Add room"
goal busy, max(count(room), 1), "rooms occupied tonight", "rooms"
row gap 2
  stat round(busy * 100 / max(count(room), 1)), "percent occupied, target" target
  stat sum(stay where paid = no, it.nights * it.room.rate), "unpaid stays"
  stat count(stay where checkin = today), "arrivals today"
section "Rooms tonight"
  grid 2 gap 1
    each room sort name as r empty "No rooms yet. Add your rooms with Add room."
      stack radius 10 pad 1 gap 0 fill if(occupied(r) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit r
        r.name bold color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, ink)
        if(occupied(r) > 0, "Occupied", "Free") faint color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, muted)
section "Check in a guest"
  form stay, "Check in"
section "Arriving soon", "next stays"
  each stay where checkin >= today sort checkin top 4 as s empty "No arrivals coming."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        s.guest bold
        s.room.name "-" s.nights "nights" faint
      s.checkin faint
section "Income", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(stay week of it, it.nights * it.room.rate), monthday(it)
section "Nights by room", "this month"
  share stay month by room.name, sum(it.nights), it.key
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each room top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Rate per night" faint
      x.rate bold

app "Sprint" target mint
table task title text, points num 1..13 = 3, owner pick Ali|Sara|Bilal|Hina = Ali, stage pick Todo|Doing|Review|Done = Todo
setting commit num = 40 "Points committed"
let done_pts = sum(task.points where stage = Done)
topbar task, "Add task"
goal done_pts, commit, "points done this sprint", "pts"
grid 2 gap 1
  each options task.stage as s
    stack card gap 1
      row
        s head grow
        sum(task.points where stage = s) "pts" faint
      each task where stage = s as t empty "Empty"
        stack radius 8 pad 1 fill soft gap 0 tap edit t swipe remove t
          t.title bold
          t.owner "-" t.points "pts" faint
section "Points done per person"
  bars task where stage = Done by owner, sum(it.points), it.key
section "Load per person", "all open work"
  share task where stage != Done by owner, sum(it.points), it.key
section "Tasks added", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(task on it)
section "Waiting for review", "stuck in the review column"
  each task where stage = Review as t empty "Nothing waiting for review."
    row gap 2
      t.title bold grow
      t.owner faint
      button "Merge" tap set t.stage = Done
section "Points left", "to hit the commitment"
  row gap 2
    stat commit - done_pts, "pts to go"
    stat sum(task.points where stage = Doing), "pts in progress"
    stat count(task), "tasks in all"
if done_pts >= commit
  "Commitment met. Pull one more task." color good bold
section "Points per person", "committed"
  each options task.owner as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(task.points where owner = v) "pts" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(task.points where owner = v) / max(commit / 4, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

section "Past years", "zakat paid"

    bars yearly sort year top 6, it.amount, it.year
  else
    "No year saved yet. Tap Save for this year." faint

app "Udhaar Book" book grey
table customer name text, phone text?
table entry customer ref customer, amount money, kind pick Credit|Payment = Credit, item text?
setting limit money = 20000 "Credit limit per customer"
let out = sum(entry.amount where kind = Credit) - sum(entry.amount where kind = Payment)
topbar customer, "Add customer"
statcard out, "outstanding from" count(customer) "customers"
row gap 2
  stat sum(entry.amount week where kind = Credit), "credit given this week"
  stat sum(entry.amount week where kind = Payment), "received this week"
section "Customers", "balance owed"
  each customer sort name as c empty "No customers yet. Add the first one with Add customer."
    row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      stack grow gap 0
        c.name bold
        c.phone faint
      sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Credit) - sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Payment) bold
section "Recovery", "payments, last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(entry.amount on it where kind = Payment)
section "Credit and payments", "this month"
  share entry month by kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Add an entry"
  form entry, "Save entry"
section "Latest entries"
  list entry by day, "No entries yet."
section "Credit against payments", "this month"
  each options entry.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(entry.amount month where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(entry.amount month where kind = v) / max(sum(entry.amount month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if out > limit * 5
  "Outstanding credit is large. Ask for payments." color warn bold
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each customer top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.phone faint
      count(x.entry) "entries" bold

let out = sum(entry.amount where kind = Credit) - sum(entry.amount where kind = Payment)
topbar customer, "Add customer"

row gap 2
  stat sum(entry.amount week where kind = Credit), "credit given this week"
  stat sum(entry.amount week where kind = Payment), "received this week"
section "Customers", "balance owed"
  each customer sort name as c empty "No customers yet. Add the first one with Add customer."
    row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      stack grow gap 0
        c.name bold
        c.phone faint
      sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Credit) - sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Payment) bold
section "Recovery", "payments, last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(entry.amount on it where kind = Payment)
section "Credit and payments", "this month"
  share entry month by kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Add an entry"
  form entry, "Save entry"
section "Latest entries"
  list entry by day, "No entries yet."
section "Credit against payments", "this month"
  each options entry.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(entry.amount month where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(entry.amount month where kind = v) / max(sum(entry.amount month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

  "Outstanding credit is large. Ask for payments." color warn bold
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each customer top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.phone faint
      count(x.entry) "entries" bold

table act what text = "Kind act", who pick Family|Friend|Neighbour|Stranger|Colleague = Friend, kind pick Time|Gift|Words|Help = Help
setting monthly_goal num = 30 "Acts per month"
let n = count(act month)
topbar act, "Log an act"
statcard n, "kind acts this month, goal" monthly_goal, monthly_goal
quick act, who, [Family, Friend, Neighbour]
row gap 2
  statcard streak(act), "days in a row"
  statcard count(act week), "acts this week"
  statcard count(act all), "acts in all"
section "Calendar", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(act on it), 3
section "By type", "this month"
  share act month by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Who got your kindness", "all time"
  share act by who, count(it), it.key
section "Per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(act on it)
section "Ideas for today"
  each ["Call someone you have not spoken to", "Pay for the next person", "Say thank you to a teacher", "Share your lunch"]
    row card gap 2
      icon smile
      it grow
section "Gifts and help", "this month"
  count(act month where kind = Gift or kind = Help) big
  "of" n "acts were gifts or help" faint
section "Your acts"
  list act by day, "No acts yet. Start small: hold a door, send a kind message."
row gap 2
  statcard count(act week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(act prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(act) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(act year) faint
  "Last one" since(act) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(act where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(act on it), 2

app "Brush teeth" tooth mint
table kid name text
table brush kid ref kid, slot pick Morning|Night = Morning

  daybars last 7 days, count(brush on it)
section "Month grid", "darker means more brushing"

  each kid sort name as k

section "Habit streak"
  streak(brush) "days with brushing" big
  "Best run" best(brush) "days" faint

section "Tips"
  "Two minutes, two times a day. Sing a song to keep time." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(brush week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(brush prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(brush) "entries so far" big

app "Brush teeth" tooth mint
table kid name text
table brush kid ref kid, slot pick Morning|Night = Morning
let kids = count(kid)
let full = count(days last 7 days, count(brush on it) >= kids * 2 and kids > 0)
remind "Brush your teeth!" at 7:30, 20:00
topbar kid, "Add child"
statcard count(brush today), "of" kids * 2 "brushes done today", kids * 2
each kid as k empty "No children yet. Add each child to start the chart."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit k swipe remove k
    k.name bold
    row gap 2
      row gap 1 grow
        "Morning" faint
        toggle k.brush where slot = Morning
      row gap 1 grow
        "Night" faint
        toggle k.brush where slot = Night
    weekdots count(k.brush on it) >= 2
section "Full days", "in the last 7:" full
  daybars last 7 days, count(brush on it)
section "Month grid", "darker means more brushing"
  daygrid last 28 days, count(brush on it), max(kids * 2, 1)
section "Star chart", "full days this month"
  each kid sort name as k
    row gap 1
      k.name grow
      count(days month, count(k.brush on it) >= 2) "stars" bold
section "Habit streak"
  streak(brush) "days with brushing" big
  "Best run" best(brush) "days" faint
section "Morning or night", "this month"
  share brush month by slot, count(it), it.key
section "Tips"
  "Two minutes, two times a day. Sing a song to keep time." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(brush week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(brush prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(brush) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(brush year) faint
  "Last one" since(brush) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(brush where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Packing" bag teal
table pack name text, bag pick Suitcase|Backpack|Carry_on|Kids_bag = Suitcase, grams num 0..30000 = 200 unit "g", must bool
table packed pack ref pack
state filter pick All|Suitcase|Backpack|Carry_on|Kids_bag = All
let n = count(pack)
let got = count(pack, count(it.packed all) > 0)
topbar pack, "Add item"
statcard got, "of" n "items packed", n
if got = n and n > 0
  "Everything is packed. Have a safe trip." head
row gap 1
  button "All" fill if(filter = All, accent, soft) tap set filter = All
  each options pack.bag as b
    button b count(pack where bag = b) fill if(filter = b, accent, soft) tap set filter = b
each pack where filter = All or bag = filter sort name as p empty "Nothing to pack yet. Add passports, chargers, medicines."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.name bold
      p.bag p.grams "g" faint
    if p.must
      "Must" color warn small
    toggle p.packed all
section "Weight per bag", "grams"
  share pack by bag, sum(it.grams), it.key
section "Still to pack", "must-have items first"
  each pack sort name as p empty "No items yet."
    if count(p.packed all) = 0
      row gap 2
        p.name grow
        p.bag faint
section "Heaviest items"
  each pack sort grams desc top 3 as p empty "No items yet."
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      p.grams "g" bold
section "Total weight"
  round(sum(pack.grams) / 100) / 10 "kg in all" big
  "Carry-on limit is usually 7 kg." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(packed week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(packed prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(packed) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(packed year) faint
  "Last one" since(packed) "days ago" faint

request: The "Rush job if due within (days)" setting: 2
program_before:
app "Tailor Shop" pen plum
table job customer text, kind pick Shalwar_kameez|Waistcoat|Blouse|Suit|Alteration = Shalwar_kameez, due date, price money, advance money = 0, done bool
setting rush num = 3 "Rush job if due within (days)"
let balance = sum(job, it.price - it.advance)
topbar job, "New job"
statcard balance, "still to collect on" count(job where done = no) "open jobs"
row gap 2
  stat count(job where done = no and due <= today + rush), "rush jobs"
  stat sum(job.advance month), "advances this month"
  stat count(job where done = yes), "finished"
section "Open jobs", "by due date"
  each job where done = no sort due as j empty "No open jobs. Add the next stitching order."
    row card gap 2 tap edit j swipe remove j
      toggle j.done
      stack grow gap 0
        j.customer bold
        j.kind "- due" j.due faint color if(j.due <= today + rush, warn, muted)
      stack gap 0 align end
        j.price - j.advance bold
        "to pay" tiny faint
section "Jobs by garment", "all time"
  share job by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Income per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(job.price week of it where done = yes), monthday(it)
section "Finished"
  list job where done = yes top 5, "No finished jobs yet."
section "Money owed", "balance per customer"
  each job where done = no sort price desc top 4 as j
    row gap 2
      j.customer bold grow
      j.price - j.advance bold
section "Advance taken", "this month"
  goal sum(job.advance month), max(sum(job.price month), 1), "of the month's job value"
section "Jobs started", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(job on it)
if count(job where done = no and due < today) > 0
  "Some jobs are past their due date." color bad bold
section "Open jobs per garment", "not finished"
  each options job.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(job where kind = v and done = no) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(job where kind = v and done = no) / max(count(job where done = no), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Salon" tag plum
table client name text, phone text?
table service name text, price money
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3

screen home "Today" calendar
  stat income, "income this month"

  form visit, "Book appointment"
  each visit today as v
    row card
      v.client.name bold grow
      v.service.name

screen clients "Clients" users
  each client sort name as c
    row card tap edit c swipe remove c
      c.name bold grow
      count(c.visit) "visits" faint
  form client, "Add client"
screen prices "Prices" tag
  list service
  form service, "Add service"
screen stock "Stock" package
  each product sort qty as p
    row card gap 1 tap edit p
      p.name bold grow color if(p.qty <= p.low, warn, ink)
      button "-" tap set p.qty = p.qty - 1
      p.qty bold
      button "+" tap set p.qty = p.qty + 1
  form product, "Add product"
screen money "Income" wallet
  stat income, "this month"
  stat sum(visit.paid prev month), "last month"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(visit.paid on it)
  list visit by day

app "Committee" users grey
table member name text
table pay member ref member, amount money = 5000
setting share money = 5000 "Share per member"
let pot = sum(pay.amount month)
let full = count(member) * share
let behind = count(member, count(it.pay month) = 0)
topbar member, "Add member"
statcard pot, "collected of" full, full
if count(member) > 0
  "Takes the pot this month:" nth(member sort name, (month(today) - 1) % count(member) + 1).name bold
section "Members", "tick when the share is paid"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add everyone in the committee."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      toggle m.pay month
      m.name bold grow
      if count(m.pay month) = 0
        "Due" color bad
      else
        "Paid" color good
section "Collection", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(pay.amount month of it), monthname(it)
row gap 2
  stat behind, "still to pay"
  stat count(member) - behind, "paid"
  stat max(full - pot, 0), "missing"
section "Payments by day", "this month"
  daybars month, sum(pay.amount on it)
section "Latest payments"
  each pay top 5 as p empty "No payments yet this month."
    row gap 2
      p.member.name bold grow
      p.amount faint
section "Paid share", "each member this month"
  each member sort name as m
    row gap 2
      m.name bold grow
      sum(m.pay.amount month) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(m.pay.amount month) / max(share, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

Edit request: move the "Collection" card belwo the "Paid share" card

Current program:
app "Committee" users grey
table member name text
table pay member ref member, amount money = 5000
setting share money = 5000 "Share per member"
let pot = sum(pay.amount month)
let full = count(member) * share
let behind = count(member, count(it.pay month) = 0)
topbar member, "Add member"
statcard pot, "collected of" full, full
if count(member) > 0
  "Takes the pot this month:" nth(member sort name, (month(today) - 1) % count(member) + 1).name bold
section "Members", "tick when the share is paid"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add everyone in the committee."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      toggle m.pay month
      m.name bold grow
      if count(m.pay month) = 0
        "Due" color bad
      else
        "Paid" color good
section "Collection", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(pay.amount month of it), monthname(it)
row gap 2
  stat behind, "still to pay"
  stat count(member) - behind, "paid"
  stat max(full - pot, 0), "missing"
section "Payments by day", "this month"
  daybars month, sum(pay.amount on it)
section "Latest payments"
  each pay top 5 as p empty "No payments yet this month."
    row gap 2
      p.member.name bold grow
      p.amount faint
section "Paid share", "each member this month"
  each member sort name as m
    row gap 2
      m.name bold grow
      sum(m.pay.amount month) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(m.pay.amount month) / max(share, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

program_before:
app "Pharmacy Stock" pill teal
table item name text, qty num 0.. = 20, low num 0.. = 10, expiry date, cost money
setting soon num = 60 "Warn this many days before expiry"
let short = count(item, it.qty <= it.low)
let expiring = count(item, it.expiry <= today + soon and it.qty > 0)
topbar item, "Add medicine"
row gap 2
  stat short, "running low"
  stat expiring, "expiring soon"
  stat sum(item, it.qty * it.cost), "stock value"
section "Lowest stock", "top 6"
  bars item sort qty top 6, it.qty, it.name
each item sort expiry as i empty "No medicines yet. Add each one with its expiry date."
  row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow gap 0
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      "Expires" i.expiry faint color if(i.expiry <= today + soon, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
section "Stock value by item", "top 5"
  share item sort qty * cost desc top 5, it.qty * it.cost, it.name
section "Expiring soon", "oldest first"
  each item where expiry <= today + soon and qty > 0 sort expiry top 4 as i empty "Nothing expires soon."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.expiry faint color bad
      i.qty "left" faint
section "Reorder list", "at or below the low level"
  each item where qty <= low sort qty top 5 as i empty "Nothing to reorder."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "of" i.low faint
if short > 3
  "Many items are low. Place an order today." color warn bold
section "Stock cover", "lowest five by percent of low level"
  each item sort qty / max(low, 1) top 5 as i
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "of" i.low faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(i.qty / max(i.low * 2, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, accent) radius 2

app "Uptime" bolt ink
table incident service pick Auth|Payments|Search|Gateway|Email = Gateway, severity pick Minor|Major|Outage = Minor, down num 1..600 = 10 unit "min", resolved bool
setting slo num = 99.9 "Uptime target (percent)"
let lost = sum(incident.down month)
let minutes = monthdays(today) * 1440
let uptime = round((1 - lost / minutes) * 10000) / 100
topbar incident, "Log incident"
statcard uptime, "percent uptime, target" slo, 100
row gap 2
  stat lost, "minutes down this month"
  stat count(incident month where severity = Outage), "full outages"
  stat count(incident where resolved = no), "still open"

  "Below the target. Error budget is spent." color bad bold
section "Open incidents", "tick when resolved"

    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.resolved
      stack grow gap 0
        i.service i.severity bold color if(i.severity = Outage, bad, ink)
        i.down "min down" faint
section "Downtime per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(incident.down on it)
section "Which service fails", "minutes down, all time"
  share incident by service, sum(it.down), it.key
section "Severity mix", "this month"
  bars incident month by severity, count(it), it.key
section "History"
  list incident where resolved = yes top 5, "No resolved incidents yet."
section "Minutes down per service", "this month"
  each options incident.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(incident.down month where service = v) "min" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(incident.down month where service = v) / max(lost, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last incident"

    row card gap 2

table food name text, kind pick Cooked|Dairy|Veg|Meat|Other = Cooked, made date = today, lasts num 1..30 = 3 unit "days"

table food name text, kind pick Cooked|Dairy|Veg|Meat|Other = Cooked, made date = today, lasts num 1..30 = 3 unit "days"
table eaten food ref food
let fresh = count(food, count(it.eaten all) = 0)
let old = count(food, count(it.eaten all) = 0 and today - it.made > it.lasts)
topbar food, "Add food"
row gap 2
  statcard fresh, "items in the fridge"
  statcard old, "past their day"
if old > 0
  "Some food is past its day. Smell it, then decide." color warn bold
section "Eat first", "oldest first"
  each food sort made as f empty "The fridge is empty. Add what you cooked tonight."
    if count(f.eaten all) = 0
      row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
        stack grow gap 0
          f.name bold
          if today - f.made > f.lasts
            "Past its day by" today - f.made - f.lasts "days" color bad small
          else
            f.lasts - (today - f.made) "days left" faint
        toggle f.eaten all
section "By type"
  share food by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Eaten per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(eaten on it)
section "Cooked per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(food week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Longest lasting"
  max(food.lasts) "days" big
row gap 2
  statcard count(eaten week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(eaten prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(eaten) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(eaten year) faint
  "Last one" since(eaten) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(eaten where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(eaten on it), 2

table project buyer text was client, item pick Door|Bed|Cupboard|Table|Chair = Door, price money, advance money = 0, stage pick Quote|Cutting|Assembly|Polish|Delivered = Quote, due date
table material what text, cost money
setting slots num = 6 "Jobs the workshop can hold"
let open = count(project where stage != Delivered)
let balance = sum(project where stage != Delivered, it.price - it.advance)
topbar project, "New job"
goal open, slots, "jobs in the workshop", "jobs"
row gap 2
  stat balance, "to collect from clients"
  stat sum(material.cost month), "wood and fittings this month"
  stat sum(project.price month where stage = Delivered), "delivered this month"
scroll gap 1
  each options project.stage as s
    stack card gap 0 width 120
      s bold
      count(project where stage = s) big
      sum(project.price where stage = s) faint
section "Open jobs", "soonest due first"
  each project where stage != Delivered sort due as p empty "No open jobs. Quote the next customer."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.buyer p.item bold
        p.stage "- due" p.due faint color if(p.due < today, bad, muted)
      stack gap 0 align end
        p.price - p.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Jobs by item", "all time"
  share project by item, count(it), it.key
section "Materials", "latest"
  list material top 4, "No materials bought yet."
  form material, "Add material"
section "Income per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(project.price week of it where stage = Delivered), monthday(it)
section "Open jobs per item", "not delivered"
  each options project.item as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(project where item = v and stage != Delivered) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(project where item = v and stage != Delivered) / max(open, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(project where stage != Delivered and due < today) > 0
  "A job is past its due date. Call the client." color bad bold

program_before:
app "Eid shopping" bag green
table buy item text, for_who text, shop text?, price money, kind pick Clothes|Shoes|Food|Gifts|Decor = Clothes
table got buy ref buy
setting budget money = 40000 "Eid budget"
let spent = sum(buy, it.price * count(it.got all))
let planned = sum(buy.price)
topbar buy, "Add item"
row gap 2
  statcard round(spent), "spent so far, budget" budget, budget
  statcard count(buy, count(it.got all) = 0), "items left to buy"
if planned > budget
  "The list is above your budget by" planned - budget color warn bold
section "Shopping list"
  each buy sort for_who as b empty "Nothing on the list yet. Start with the children's clothes."
    row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
      stack grow gap 0
        b.item bold
        b.for_who b.shop faint
      b.price faint
      toggle b.got all
section "By kind", "planned"
  share buy by kind, sum(it.price), it.key
section "By person", "planned"
  share buy by for_who, sum(it.price), it.key
section "Shops to visit"
  share buy where shop != "" by shop, count(it), it.key
section "Days to go"
  "Plan to finish a week early so the last days are calm." faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(got week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(got prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(got) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(got year) faint
  "Last one" since(got) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(got where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(got on it), 2

table member name text, turn num 1..30
table pay member ref member, amount money
setting dues money = 5000 "Monthly share per member"
let n = count(member)
let paid_now = count(member, count(it.pay month) > 0)
let pot = n * dues
topbar member, "Add member"
row gap 2
  statcard paid_now, "of" n "paid this month", n
  statcard pot, "pot this month"
section "Still to pay", "this month"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet."
    if count(m.pay month) = 0
      row gap 2
        m.name grow
        dues faint
section "Members", "tap the tick when paid"
  each member sort turn as m empty "No members yet. Add each person and their turn number."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.name bold
        "Turn" m.turn faint
      toggle m.pay month
section "Whose turn", monthname(today)
  each member sort turn top 1 as m empty "Add members first."
    row gap 2
      m.name head grow
      pot bold
section "Collected per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(pay.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Rounds left"
  max(n - month(today), 0) big
  "months until everyone has had a turn, if you started in January" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(pay week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(pay prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(pay) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(pay year) faint
  "Last one" since(pay) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(pay where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Light bill" bolt orange
table month units num 0..3000, label text
state units num = 220
state tax num = 17
setting fixed money = 150 "Fixed charge"
let rate = if(units <= 100, 7, if(units <= 200, 11, if(units <= 300, 17, 24)))
let energy = units * rate
let bill = energy * (1 + tax / 100) + fixed
section "Meter reading"
  "Units used" units faint
  slider units 0..800
  "Tax" tax "%" faint
  slider tax 0..25
if units = 0
  "Slide the units to see the bill." faint
else
  statcard round(bill), "estimated bill"
  row gap 2
    stat rate, "per unit slab"
    stat round(energy), "energy charge"
  button "Save this month" tap add month units = units, label = monthname(today)
section "Saved months", "units"
  if count(month) > 0
    bars month top 6, it.units, it.label
  else
    "Nothing saved yet. Tap Save this month." faint

app "Electric Bill" bolt mint dark
table ebill units num 1..5000 unit "units", amount money
let unitcost = sum(ebill.amount) / max(1, sum(ebill.units))
topbar ebill, "Add bill"
stack card gap 2
  "Latest bill" faint
  if count(ebill) = 0
    "No bills yet" head
  else
    last(ebill.amount) big
    last(ebill.units) "units" faint
    if count(ebill) > 1
      if last(ebill.units) > nth(ebill sort at desc, 2).units
        "More than the month before" color bad
      else
        "Less than the month before" color good
row gap 2
  statcard round(unitcost * 10) / 10, "average cost per unit"
  statcard sum(ebill.amount year), "paid this year"
section "Units per bill"
  trend ebill, it.units
each ebill sort at desc as e empty "No bills yet. Add the first one from your paper bill."
  row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
    e.units "units" grow
    e.amount bold

table person name text, birthday date, relation pick Family|Friend|Colleague|Neighbour = Family
setting warn_days num = 14 "Warn me this many days before"
let nextbd(b date) = if(addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b))) >= today, addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b))), addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b) + 1)))
let soon = count(person where nextbd(birthday) - today <= warn_days)
topbar person, "Add person"
row gap 2
  statcard count(person), "people on the list"
  statcard soon, "birthdays in the next" warn_days "days"
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each person sort nextbd(it.birthday) top 5 as p empty "No birthdays yet. Add the people you never want to forget."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.name bold
        p.relation "turns" year(nextbd(p.birthday)) - year(p.birthday) faint
      stack gap 0 align center
        nextbd(p.birthday) - today bold
        "days" tiny color muted
section "Birthdays per month"
  bars 1..12, count(person where month(birthday) = it), monthname(addmonths(today, it - month(today)))
section "Who they are"
  share person by relation, count(it), it.key
section "Oldest and youngest"
  each person sort birthday top 1 as p empty "Add people to see this."
    row gap 2
      "Oldest" faint grow
      p.name bold
  each person sort birthday desc top 1 as p empty "Add people to see this."
    row gap 2
      "Youngest" faint grow
      p.name bold
section "This month", monthname(today)
  each person where month(birthday) = month(today) sort monthday(birthday) as p empty "Nobody has a birthday this month."
    row gap 2
      p.name grow
      "on the" monthday(p.birthday) faint
section "Everyone"

row gap 2
  statcard count(person week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(person prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(person) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(person year) faint
  "Last one" since(person) "days ago" faint

table person name text, birthday date, relation pick Family|Friend|Colleague|Neighbour = Family
setting warn_days num = 14 "Warn me this many days before"
let nextbd(b date) = if(addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b))) >= today, addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b))), addmonths(b, 12 * (year(today) - year(b) + 1)))
let soon = count(person where nextbd(birthday) - today <= warn_days)

  statcard soon, "birthdays in the next" warn_days "days"

        nextbd(p.birthday) - today bold
        "days" tiny color muted
section "Birthdays per month"
  bars 1..12, count(person where month(birthday) = it), monthname(addmonths(today, it - month(today)))

section "Oldest and youngest"

    row gap 2
      "Oldest" faint grow

      p.name bold

  statcard count(person week), "entries this week"

app "Fleet Care" car slate
table vehicle plate text, kind pick Truck|Van|Pickup|Bike = Truck
table service vehicle ref vehicle, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Engine|Inspection = Oil, cost money, km num 0..900000
setting interval num = 90 "Service every (days)"
let due = count(vehicle, due(it.service, interval))
topbar vehicle, "Add vehicle"
row gap 2
  stat count(vehicle), "vehicles"
  stat due, "due for service"
  stat sum(service.cost month), "spent this month"
section "Vehicles", "oldest service first"
  each vehicle sort since(it.service) desc as v empty "No vehicles yet. Add your first truck or van."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.plate bold
        v.kind "- last service" since(v.service) "days ago" faint color if(due(v.service, interval), bad, muted)
      sum(v.service.cost) bold
section "Cost per vehicle", "all time"
  bars vehicle, sum(it.service.cost), it.plate
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(service.cost month of it), monthname(it)
section "Work done", "by type"
  share service by work, count(it), it.key
section "Log a service"
  form service, "Save service"
list service top 5, "No services logged yet."
section "Vehicles per kind", "fleet size"
  each options vehicle.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(vehicle where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(vehicle where kind = v) / max(count(vehicle), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Due now"
  each vehicle where due(service, interval) as v empty "No vehicle is due. Everything is serviced."
    row gap 2
      v.plate bold grow
      "Due" color bad
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each vehicle top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.plate bold
        x.kind faint
      sum(x.service.cost) bold

app "Watchlist" cards purple
table title name text, kind pick Movie|Series|Documentary|Anime = Movie, status pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want, stars num? 1..5, finished date?
state tab pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want
topbar title, "Add title"
row gap 2
  statcard count(title where status = Watched), "watched"
  statcard count(title where status = Want), "on the list"
row gap 1
  each options title.status as s
    button s count(title where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each title where status = tab sort name as t empty "Nothing here yet. Add a film someone told you about."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.name bold
      t.kind t.stars faint
    if t.status = Want
      button "Start" tap set t.status = Watching
    if t.status = Watching
      button "Finished" tap set t.status = Watched then set t.finished = today
section "Watched per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(title where finished >= addmonths(today, it - 6) and finished < addmonths(today, it - 5)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "What you like", "watched by kind"
  share title where status = Watched by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Top rated"
  each title sort stars desc top 3 as t empty "Rate a title to see your favourites."
    row gap 2
      t.name grow
      t.stars "stars" bold
section "Average rating"
  round(avg(title.stars) * 10) / 10 big
  "out of 5 across" count(title where stars > 0) "rated titles" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(title week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(title prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(title) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(title year) faint
  "Last one" since(title) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(title where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(title on it), 2

table title name text, kind pick Movie|Series|Documentary|Anime = Movie, status pick Want|Watching|Watched|Dropped = Want, stars num? 1..5, finished date?
state tab pick Want|Watching|Watched|Dropped = Want
topbar title, "Add title"
row gap 2
  statcard count(title where status = Watched), "watched"
  statcard count(title where status = Want), "on the list"
row gap 1
  each options title.status as s
    button s count(title where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each title where status = tab sort name as t empty "Nothing here yet. Add a film someone told you about."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.name bold
      t.kind t.stars faint
    if t.status = Want
      button "Start" tap set t.status = Watching
    if t.status = Watching
      button "Finished" tap set t.status = Watched then set t.finished = today
section "Watched per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(title where finished >= addmonths(today, it - 6) and finished < addmonths(today, it - 5)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "What you like", "watched by kind"
  share title where status = Watched by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Top rated"
  each title sort stars desc top 3 as t empty "Rate a title to see your favourites."
    row gap 2
      t.name grow
      t.stars "stars" bold
section "Average rating"
  round(avg(title.stars) * 10) / 10 big
  "out of 5 across" count(title where stars > 0) "rated titles" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(title week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(title prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(title) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(title year) faint
  "Last one" since(title) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(title where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(title on it), 2

table campaign name text, channel pick Facebook|Google|Instagram|Flyers|WhatsApp = Facebook, spend money, leads num 0..5000 = 0, sales num 0..5000 = 0

program_before:
app "Doctor visits" heart teal
table visit doctor text, kind pick GP|Dentist|Eye|Child|Lab|Specialist = GP, day date, cost money?, note text?
setting yearly_budget money = 30000 "Health budget per year"
let spent = sum(visit.cost year)
let upcoming = count(visit where day >= today)
remind "Doctor visit tomorrow" at visit.day - 1d at 18:00
topbar visit, "Add visit"
row gap 2
  statcard upcoming, "visits coming up"
  statcard count(visit year where day < today), "visits this year"
statcard spent, "spent on health this year, budget" yearly_budget, yearly_budget
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each visit where day >= today sort day as v empty "No visits planned. Book your check-up and add it here."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.doctor bold
        v.kind v.day faint
      "in" v.day - today "days" faint
section "Cost by kind", "this year"
  share visit year by kind, sum(it.cost), it.key
section "Spending per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(visit.cost month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Visits per kind", "all time"
  each options visit.kind as k
    row gap 1
      k grow
      count(visit where kind = k) bold
section "Biggest bill", "this year"
  max(visit.cost year) big
  "Average per visit" round(avg(visit.cost year)) faint
section "Notes to remember"
  each visit where note != "" top 4 as v empty "No notes yet. Write what the doctor said when you add a visit."
    row gap 2
      v.note grow
      v.day faint
section "Past visits"
  each visit where day < today sort day desc as v empty "No past visits recorded."
    row gap 2 tap edit v
      v.doctor v.day grow
      v.cost bold
row gap 2
  statcard count(visit week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(visit prev week), "entries last week"

app "Photo walks" eye ink
table walkp place text, theme pick Street|Nature|People|Buildings|Light = Street, shots num 1..500 = 20 unit "shots", keepers num 0..100 = 3

  statcard count(walkp month), "walks this month"

  share walkp sort keepers desc top 5, it.keepers, it.place

  each walkp sort keepers desc top 1 as w empty "No walks yet."
    row gap 2
      w.place bold grow
      w.keepers "keepers" faint
section "Walk days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(walkp on it), 1
section "Since the last walk"
  since(walkp) big
  "days ago" faint
section "All walks"
  list walkp by day, "No walks yet. Take the camera for twenty minutes around your street."

app "Clinic Queue" heart teal
table patient name text, reason pick Fever|Checkup|Injury|Child|Other = Checkup, status pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting, fee money = 500

state tab pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting
topbar patient, "Add patient"
goal count(patient today), capacity, "patients seen or waiting today", "patients"
row gap 2
  stat count(patient where status = Waiting), "waiting now"
  stat count(patient today where status = Done), "done today"
  stat sum(patient.fee today where status = Done), "fees collected"
row gap 1
  each options patient.status as s
    button s count(patient today where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each patient today where status = tab sort at as p empty "Nobody in this list right now."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    text index + 1 bold
    stack grow gap 0
      p.name bold
      p.reason faint
    if p.status = Waiting
      button "Call in" tap set p.status = With_doctor
    if p.status = With_doctor
      button "Done" tap set p.status = Done
section "Patients per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, count(patient on it), capacity
section "Reasons", "this month"
  share patient month by reason, count(it), it.key
section "Fees per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(patient.fee on it where status = Done)
section "Busiest weekday"
  each options patient.reason as r
    row gap 2
      r bold grow
      count(patient week where reason = r) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(patient week where reason = r) / max(count(patient week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(patient where status = Waiting) > 10
  "Long queue. Call a second doctor." color warn bold
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each patient top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold

      x.fee bold

app "Guitar" music plum
table practice mins num 5..240 unit "min", focus pick Chords|Scales|Songs|Rhythm|Ear = Songs, note text?

quick practice, mins, [10, 20, 30]
row gap 2

    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s

      s.level faint
      if s.level = Learning
        button "Almost" tap set s.level = Almost
      if s.level = Almost
        button "Got it" tap set s.level = Mastered
  form song, "Add song"
section "Hours so far"
  round(sum(practice.mins) / 60) "hours of practice in all" big
  "Longest session" max(practice.mins) "min" faint
section "Sessions"
  list practice by day, "No practice yet. Tap 10 and play one slow chord change."
row gap 2
  statcard count(practice week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(practice prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(practice) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(practice year) faint
  "Last one" since(practice) "days ago" faint

  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(practice where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Fuel" car orange
table fill litres num 1..120 unit "L", price money, odo num 0..999999 unit "km"
setting tank num = 45 "Tank size (litres)"
let km_used = last(fill.odo) - first(fill.odo)
let kpl = km_used / max(sum(fill.litres) - first(fill.litres), 1)
topbar fill, "Add fill-up"
row gap 2
  statcard round(kpl * 10) / 10, "km per litre overall"
  statcard round(sum(fill.price month)), "spent on fuel this month"

  bars 1..6, sum(fill.price month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))

  trend fill last 180 days, it.litres
section "Price paid", "per fill-up"
  trend fill last 180 days, it.price
section "Cost per km"

  "Total fuel cost" sum(fill.price) faint
section "Fill-ups per month"
  daybars last 30 days, count(fill on it)
section "Range left", "from the last fill-up"
  round(kpl * tank) "km on a full tank" big
section "Records"
  list fill by day, "No fill-ups yet. Add the litres, the price and the odometer each time."

  statcard count(fill week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(fill prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"

  "Last one" since(fill) "days ago" faint

app "Juice Bar" cup orange
table sale drink pick Orange|Mango|Sugarcane|Carrot|Mix = Orange, price money = 150
setting target money = 12000 "Daily takings target"
state flavour pick Orange|Mango|Sugarcane|Carrot|Mix = Orange
"Juice Bar" head
choice flavour
quick sale, price, [100, 150, 200, 250]
button "Sell a" flavour "for 150" tap add sale drink = flavour, price = 150
statcard sum(sale.price today), "taken today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat count(sale today), "glasses today"
  stat count(sale week), "glasses this week"
  stat round(sum(sale.price today) / max(count(sale today), 1)), "average per glass"
section "Takings", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(sale.price on it), target
section "Flavours", "glasses this week"
  share sale week by drink, count(it), it.key
section "Flavours today"
  each options sale.drink as f
    row gap 2
      f bold grow
      count(sale today where drink = f) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 70
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(sale today where drink = f) / max(count(sale today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(sale on it), 40
list sale today, "No sales yet today. Tap a price when the first glass goes."
section "Best day", "this month"
  stat max(days month, sum(sale.price on it)), "taken in one day"
section "Totals", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat count(sale month), "glasses"
    stat sum(sale.price month), "takings"
if count(sale today) = 0
  "Quiet so far today. Set up the fruit." faint
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each sale top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.drink bold
        x.at faint
      x.price bold

setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting silver num = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
state bill money = 0
state tip num = 10
state people num = 1
let wealth = cash + gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate - debts
let nisab = 612.36 * silver_rate
screen zakat "Zakat" coin
  field cash
  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_rate
  field silver_rate
  field debts
  if(wealth >= nisab, "Zakat due (2.5%)", "Below nisab: no zakat due") faint
  round(if(wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)) big
screen split "Tip" calc
  field bill "Bill"
  "Tip" tip "%" faint
  slider tip 0..30
  slider people 1..20
  "Tip" round(bill * tip / 100) head
  "Each pays" round(bill * (1 + tip / 100) / people) big

list point

table subject name text
table lesson subject ref subject, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat = Mon, start time, mins num 15..180 = 45
table studied subject ref subject, mins num 1..
table flash word text, meaning text
setting work dur = 10m "Focus length" set
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
state sub ref subject
screen plan "Timetable" calendar
  each options lesson.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold
      each lesson where day = dd sort start as l
        row card tap edit l swipe remove l
          l.start l.subject.name grow
          l.mins "min"
  form lesson, "Add lesson"
  form subject, "Add subject"
screen focus "Focus" timer
  choice sub
  timer work, "Focus", add studied subject = sub, mins = 25 then notify "Break time"
  sum(studied.mins today) "min studied today" head
screen cards "Cards" cards
  each flash sort at as c
    if index = i
      stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
        if flipped
          c.meaning big
        else
          c.word big
  row gap 1
    button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
    button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  form flash, "Add card"
screen progress "Progress" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(studied.mins on it)
  share subject, sum(it.studied.mins week), it.name

setting weekly_goal num = 240 "Minutes per week"
let wk = sum(train.mins week)
topbar train, "Log training"
statcard wk, "min this week, goal" weekly_goal, weekly_goal
row gap 2
  statcard sum(train.goals month), "goals scored this month"
  statcard count(train week), "sessions this week"
  statcard streak(train), "day streak"
section "Minutes per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(train.mins on it), weekly_goal / 7
section "Drills", "this month"
  share train month by drill, sum(it.mins), it.key
section "Goals in matches", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, sum(train.goals week of (today - 7 * (8 - it)) where drill = Match), join("W", it)
section "Training days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(train on it), 2
section "Best match"
  max(train.goals where drill = Match) "goals" big
section "Quick log"
  row gap 1
    button "30 min pass" tap add train mins = 30, drill = Passing
    button "45 min shoot" tap add train mins = 45, drill = Shooting
section "Sessions"
  list train by day, "No sessions yet. Log your next kickabout."
row gap 2
  statcard count(train week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(train prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(train) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(train year) faint
  "Last one" since(train) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(train where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(train on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(train.mins) * 10) / 10 "min" big
  "Highest" max(train.mins) "min" faint
  "Lowest" min(train.mins) "min" faint

app "Club Squad" ball green
table player name text, position pick Keeper|Defender|Midfield|Striker = Midfield, shirt num 1..99 = 10 "Shirt number"
table present player ref player
setting minimum num = 11 "Players needed for a match"
let here = count(present today)
topbar player, "Add player"
goal here, minimum, "players at training today", "players"
if here >= minimum
  "Enough players for a match." color good bold
else
  "Need" minimum - here "more players today." color warn bold
section "Squad", "tap the tick when a player arrives"
  each player sort name as p empty "No players yet. Add the squad with Add player."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      toggle p.present
      stack grow gap 0
        p.name bold
        p.position faint
      count(p.present last 30 days) "of 30 days" faint
section "By position", "who is in today"
  row gap 1
    each options player.position as pos
      stack card grow gap 0 align center
        count(player where position = pos) bold
        pos faint
section "Attendance", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(present on it)
section "Most reliable", "days present in 30"
  bars player sort count(it.present last 30 days) desc top 5, count(it.present last 30 days), it.name
section "Training days", "last 6 weeks"
  daygrid last 42 days, count(present on it), max(count(player), 1)
section "Present today per position", "squad check"
  each options player.position as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(present today where player.position = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(present today where player.position = v) / max(count(player where position = v), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each player top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.position faint
      count(x.present last 30 days) "days" bold

state amt money = 1000000
state r1 num = 14

state y2 num = 5

let pay1 = if(m1 > 0, amt * m1 / (1 - pow(1 + m1, -12 * y1)), amt / (12 * y1))
let pay2 = if(m2 > 0, amt * m2 / (1 - pow(1 + m2, -12 * y2)), amt / (12 * y2))

    "Years" y1 faint
    slider y1 1..30

    "Rate" r2 "%" faint
    slider r2 0..40
    "Years" y2 faint

  statcard round(pay1), "per month, offer one"
  statcard round(pay2), "per month, offer two"

if amt > 0

table wash vehicle pick Bike|Car|Suv|Van = Car, price money = 500
table supply what text, cost money
setting target money = 10000 "Daily takings target"
"Car Wash" head
quick wash, price, [200, 500, 800, 1200]
statcard sum(wash.price today), "taken today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat count(wash today), "washes today"

  stat sum(wash.price month) - sum(supply.cost month), "left after supplies"
section "Takings", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(wash.price on it), target
section "By vehicle", "this month"

  daygrid last 35 days, count(wash on it), 15

  stat sum(supply.cost month), "spent on soap and wax"
  list supply top 3, "No supplies bought yet."
  form supply, "Add supply"
list wash today, "No washes yet today. Tap a price when the first car is done."
section "Washes per vehicle", "today"
  each options wash.vehicle as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(wash today where vehicle = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(wash today where vehicle = v) / max(count(wash today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last 7 days", "washes"
  daybars last 7 days, count(wash on it)
if sum(wash.price today) >= target
  "Daily target reached." color good bold
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each wash top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.vehicle bold
        x.at faint
      x.price bold

  field kit "Kit cost"

  field pmil "Petrol km per litre"
  field cng "CNG per kg"
  field cmil "CNG km per kg"

  statcard round(p_cost), "petrol a month"
  statcard round(c_cost), "CNG a month"

else
  statcard round(save), "saved a month"

app "Bike Hire" bike yellow
table rental rider text, bike pick City|Mountain|Electric = City, hours num 1..48 = 2 unit "h", rate money = 150, returned bool

let out = count(rental where returned = no)
topbar rental, "New rental"
goal out, fleet, "bikes out right now", "bikes"
row gap 2
  stat fleet - out, "bikes in the shop"
  stat sum(rental, it.hours * it.rate), "total rented value"
  stat sum(rental today, it.hours * it.rate), "income today"
section "Out now", "tick when the bike comes back"
  each rental where returned = no sort at as r empty "All bikes are back in the shop."
    row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r

      stack grow gap 0
        r.rider bold
        r.bike "-" r.hours "h at" r.rate faint
      r.hours * r.rate bold
section "Income by bike", "this month"
  share rental month by bike, sum(it, it.hours * it.rate), it.key
section "Rentals per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(rental on it)
section "Hours per bike type"
  each options rental.bike as b
    row gap 2
      b bold grow
      sum(rental.hours month where bike = b) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(rental.hours month where bike = b) / max(sum(rental.hours month), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Busy weekends", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(rental on it), 6
section "Returned", count(rental where returned = yes)
  list rental where returned = yes top 4, "Nothing returned yet."
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each rental top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x

        x.rider bold
        x.bike faint
      x.hours "h" bold

section "Prizes", "coins in the jar:" coins
  each prize sort cost as p empty "No prizes yet. Add something to save up for."
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      p.cost "coins" faint
      if coins >= p.cost
        button "Get it" fill accent tap add bought prize = p
      else
        "needs" p.cost - coins "more" faint
form prize, "Add prize"

program_before:
app "Scrap Yard" tool teal
table buy item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..2000 = 50 unit "kg", rate money
table sold item pick Iron|Copper|Paper|Plastic|Aluminium = Iron, kg num 1..5000 = 100 unit "kg", rate money
setting capacity num = 3000 "Yard capacity (kg)"
let stock = sum(buy.kg) - sum(sold.kg)
let margin = sum(sold, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(buy, it.kg * it.rate)
topbar buy, "Log purchase"
goal stock, capacity, "kg in the yard", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(buy today, it.kg * it.rate), "bought today"
  stat sum(sold today, it.kg * it.rate), "sold today"
  stat margin, "margin so far"
section "Stock by metal", "bought minus sold"
  each options buy.item as m
    row gap 2
      m bold grow
      sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m) "kg" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp((sum(buy.kg where item = m) - sum(sold.kg where item = m)) / max(capacity / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Kilos bought per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(buy.kg on it)
section "Spend by metal", "this month"
  share buy month by item, sum(it, it.kg * it.rate), it.key
section "Sell scrap"
  form sold, "Save sale"
section "Latest sales"
  each sold top 4 as s empty "Nothing sold yet. Record the first load."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.item bold
        s.kg "kg at" s.rate faint
      s.kg * s.rate bold
section "Latest purchases"
  list buy top 4, "Nothing bought yet. Log the first purchase."
if stock > capacity
  "The yard is over capacity. Sell something." color warn bold
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each buy top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.item bold
        x.kg "kg" faint
      x.kg * x.rate bold

app "Club Dues" users red
table member name text, group pick Juniors|Seniors|Veterans = Seniors
table payment member ref member, amount money = 2000

topbar member, "Add member"

table restock cones num 50..2000 = 300
setting stock num = 200 "Cones at the start"
setting target money = 8000 "Daily takings target"
let left = stock + sum(restock.cones) - sum(sale.scoops)
topbar sale, "Add sale"
statcard sum(sale.price today), "taken today of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat sum(sale.scoops today), "scoops today"
  stat left, "cones left"
  stat last(weather.temp), "degrees now"
if left < 50
  "Cones are running out. Restock before the evening rush." color warn bold
section "Takings", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(sale.price on it), target
section "Heat", "temperature, last 14 days"
  trend weather last 14 days sort at, it.temp
section "Hot days", "35 C or more, last 30 days"
  stat count(weather last 30 days where temp >= 35), "hot days"
section "Flavours", "scoops this week"
  share sale week by flavour, sum(it.scoops), it.key
section "Flavours today"
  each options sale.flavour as f
    row gap 2
      f bold grow
      sum(sale.scoops today where flavour = f) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(sale.scoops today where flavour = f) / max(sum(sale.scoops today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Today's weather"
  form weather, "Save temperature"
section "Restock cones"
  form restock, "Add cones"
list sale today, "No sales yet today. Add the first scoop."
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each sale top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.flavour bold
        x.at faint
      x.price bold

app "Concert Money" star ocean
state ng num = 0
state pg money = 500
state nv num = 0
state pv money = 2000
state ns num = 0
state ps money = 250
state costs money = 0
let sold = ng + nv + ns
let revenue = ng * pg + nv * pv + ns * ps
let avgp = if(sold > 0, revenue / sold, pg)
section "Tickets sold"
  row gap 2
    field ng "General"
    field pg "Price"
  row gap 2
    field nv "VIP"
    field pv "Price"
  row gap 2
    field ns "Students"
    field ps "Price"
field costs "Hall and sound costs"
statcard revenue, "revenue from" plural(sold, "ticket")
if costs > 0
  if revenue >= costs
    "Profit" revenue - costs color good big
  else
    "Short by" costs - revenue color bad big
    "About" 0 - floor(0 - (costs - revenue) / avgp) "more tickets to break even." faint

app "Pump Log" drop ocean
table irrigate field pick Cotton|Wheat|Orchard|Fodder = Cotton, hours num 1..24 = 4 unit "h"

setting budget num = 60 "Pump hours per week"

row gap 2
  stat sum(irrigate.hours today), "hours today"
  stat sum(diesel.litres month), "litres of diesel"

section "Watered days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(irrigate on it)
section "Fields not watered this week"
  each options irrigate.field as f
    if count(irrigate week where field = f) = 0
      row gap 2
        f bold grow
        "Thirsty" color warn
section "Diesel", "this month"
  stat sum(diesel.cost month), "spent"
  form diesel, "Add diesel"

section "Hours per field", "this week"
  each options irrigate.field as v

        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(irrigate.hours week where field = v) / max(budget / 2, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
