table irrigate field pick Cotton|Wheat|Orchard|Fodder = Cotton, hours num 1..24 = 4 unit "h"
table diesel litres num 1..200 = 20 unit "L", cost money
setting budget num = 60 "Pump hours per week"
let used = sum(irrigate.hours week)
topbar irrigate, "Log pumping"
goal used, budget, "pump hours this week", "h"
row gap 2
  stat sum(irrigate.hours today), "hours today"
  stat sum(diesel.litres month), "litres of diesel"
  stat round(sum(diesel.cost month) / max(sum(irrigate.hours month), 1)), "diesel cost per hour"
section "Hours per field", "this week"
  share irrigate week by field, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours per day", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(irrigate.hours on it), budget / 7
section "Watered days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(irrigate on it)
section "Fields not watered this week"
  each options irrigate.field as f
    if count(irrigate week where field = f) = 0
      row gap 2
        f bold grow
        "Thirsty" color warn
section "Diesel", "this month"
  stat sum(diesel.cost month), "spent"
  form diesel, "Add diesel"
list irrigate today, "No pumping logged today."
section "Hours per field", "this week"
  each options irrigate.field as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(irrigate.hours week where field = v) "h" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(irrigate.hours week where field = v) / max(budget / 2, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each irrigate top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.field bold
        x.at faint
      x.hours "h" bold

app "Book Club" book plum
table book title text, author text?, pages num 20..1500 = 250, status pick Proposed|Reading|Finished = Proposed
table vote book ref book
table reading book ref book, pages num 1..300 = 20
setting weekly num = 100 "Pages to read each week"
state tab pick Proposed|Reading|Finished = Proposed
topbar book, "Propose book"
goal sum(reading.pages week), weekly, "pages read this week", "pages"
row gap 1
  each options book.status as s
    button s count(book where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each book where status = tab sort title as b empty "No books in this list. Propose one for the next meeting."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        b.title bold
        b.author b.pages "pages" faint
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Vote" count(b.vote) tap add vote book = b
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Start" tap set b.status = Reading
      if b.status = Reading
        button "Finished" tap set b.status = Finished
    if b.status = Reading
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(b.reading.pages) / b.pages, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Votes", "proposed books"
  bars book where status = Proposed sort count(it.vote) desc top 5, count(it.vote), it.title
section "Pages per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(reading.pages on it)
section "Log reading"
  form reading, "Save pages"
section "Finished books", count(book where status = Finished)
  stat sum(book.pages where status = Finished), "pages read together"
section "Most pages", "longest proposed book"
  each book where status = Proposed sort pages desc top 2 as b empty "No proposals."
    row gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.pages "pages" faint
section "Reading streak"
  row gap 2
    stat streak(reading), "days in a row"
    stat best(reading), "best streak"
    stat sum(reading.pages month), "pages this month"
if sum(reading.pages week) >= weekly
  "Weekly reading goal reached." color good bold

state tab pick Proposed|Reading|Finished = Proposed
topbar book, "Propose book"
goal sum(reading.pages week), weekly, "pages read this week", "pages"
row gap 1
  each options book.status as s
    button s count(book where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each book where status = tab sort title as b empty "No books in this list. Propose one for the next meeting."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    row gap 2
      stack grow gap 0
        b.title bold
        b.author b.pages "pages" faint
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Vote" count(b.vote) tap add vote book = b
      if b.status = Proposed
        button "Start" tap set b.status = Reading
      if b.status = Reading
        button "Finished" tap set b.status = Finished
    if b.status = Reading
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(b.reading.pages) / b.pages, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Votes", "proposed books"
  bars book where status = Proposed sort count(it.vote) desc top 5, count(it.vote), it.title
section "Pages per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(reading.pages on it)
section "Log reading"
  form reading, "Save pages"
section "Finished books", count(book where status = Finished)
  stat sum(book.pages where status = Finished), "pages read together"
section "Most pages", "longest proposed book"
  each book where status = Proposed sort pages desc top 2 as b empty "No proposals."
    row gap 2
      b.title bold grow
      b.pages "pages" faint
section "Reading streak"
  row gap 2
    stat streak(reading), "days in a row"
    stat best(reading), "best streak"
    stat sum(reading.pages month), "pages this month"
if sum(reading.pages week) >= weekly
  "Weekly reading goal reached." color good bold

app "Meal plan" food orange
table plan dish text, day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun = Mon, slot pick Lunch|Dinner = Dinner, cost money?
setting week_budget money = 6000 "Food budget per week"
state pick_day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun = Mon
let planned = count(plan)
let cost = sum(plan.cost)
topbar plan, "Plan a dish"
row gap 1
  each options plan.day as d
    button d fill if(pick_day = d, accent, soft) tap set pick_day = d
section "Meals on" pick_day, "planned:" count(plan where day = pick_day)
  each plan where day = pick_day sort slot as p empty "Nothing planned for this day. Tap Plan a dish."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.dish bold
        p.slot faint
      p.cost faint
section "The whole week", "dishes per day"
  bars options plan.day, count(plan where day = it), it
section "Lunch or dinner"
  share plan by slot, count(it), it.key
section "Week budget", "planned:" cost
  goal cost, week_budget, "planned spending", ""
  "Average per dish" round(cost / max(count(plan, it.cost > 0), 1)) faint
section "All dishes"
  list plan sort day, "No dishes planned yet. Start with tonight's dinner."
section "Cheapest dishes"
  each plan where cost > 0 sort cost top 3 as p empty "Add costs to dishes to see this."
    row gap 2
      p.dish grow
      p.cost bold
section "Planned so far"
  planned big
  "dishes this week" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(plan week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(plan prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(plan) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(plan year) faint
  "Last one" since(plan) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(plan where dayname(at) = it), it

table item name text, supplier ref supplier, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5
screen stock "Stock" box
  topbar item, "Add item"
  each item sort qty as i empty "No items yet. Add what you stock and who supplies it."
    row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
        i.supplier.name faint
      button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
      i.qty bold
      button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
screen sup "Suppliers" users
  topbar supplier, "Add supplier"
  each supplier sort name as s empty "No suppliers yet."
    stack card gap 0 tap edit s swipe remove s
      s.name bold
      count(s.item) "items," s.phone faint
screen order "To order" cart
  each supplier as s empty "Add suppliers first."
    stack card gap 1
      s.name bold
      each s.item where qty <= low as i empty "Nothing to reorder."
        row gap 2
          i.name grow
          "only" i.qty "left" faint color warn

app "Fasting Window" hourglass ink
table fastlog hrs num 0..72
setting aim num = 16 "Fasting goal (hours)"
state started when = now
state fasting bool = no
let hrs_now = floor((now - started) / 1h)
if fasting
  stack card gap 2
    "Fasting for" faint
    hrs_now "h" big
    draw 100, 4
      rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(hrs_now / aim, 0, 1), 4 fill if(hrs_now >= aim, good, accent) radius 2
    if hrs_now >= aim
      "Goal reached. You can eat now." color good
    else
      aim - hrs_now "h to your goal" color muted
  button "End fast" fill accent tap add fastlog hrs = hrs_now then set fasting = no
else
  stack card gap 2
    "Not fasting" head
    "Your last fast was" last(fastlog.hrs) "h" color muted
  button "Start fast" fill accent tap set started = now then set fasting = yes
row gap 2
  statcard max(fastlog.hrs), "longest fast (h)"
  statcard count(fastlog month), "fasts this month"
section "Past fasts", "hours"
  trend fastlog last 60 days, it.hrs
each fastlog sort at desc top 6 as f empty "No finished fasts yet."
  row card tap edit f swipe remove f
    f.hrs "h" bold grow
    f.at faint

  each options thing.stage

table chore name text, part pick Morning|Afternoon|Evening = Morning
table chore_done chore ref chore
let n = count(chore)
count(chore_done today) "of" n "done today" head
section "Log"
  each chore
    row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
      stack grow
        it.name bold
        it.part faint
      toggle it.chore_done
form chore
section "Totals"
  stat max(chore, streak(it.chore_done)), "best streak"
remind "Time to tick off kids' chores" at 22:00

table score who text, area pick Coding|Design|Communication|Culture = Coding, mark num 1..5 = 3, note text?
topbar score, "Add mark"
section "Average by area", "out of 5"
  bars options score.area, avg(score.mark where area = it), it
each score by who as g empty "No marks yet. Add one after the interview."
  row card gap 2
    stack grow gap 0
      g.key bold
      sum(g.mark) "points in total" faint
    fixed(avg(g.mark), 1) big
    if(avg(g.mark) >= 4, "Strong yes", if(avg(g.mark) >= 3, "Maybe", "No")) bold

table ride km num 0.5..80, tip money = 0
table petrol amount money, litres num 1..20
setting per_km money = 25 "Fare per km"
let earned = sum(ride.km week) * per_km + sum(ride.tip week)
"Earned this week" earned big
"After petrol" earned - sum(petrol.amount week) head color if(earned > sum(petrol.amount week), good, bad)
"Per km" fixed((earned - sum(petrol.amount week)) / sum(ride.km week), 1) faint
daybars last 7 days, sum(ride.km on it) * per_km
form ride, "Add ride"
form petrol, "Petrol"

let nospace = not has(pw, " ")

app "Piece Rate" pen slate
table sworker name text
table stitched sworker ref sworker, kind pick Shirt|Trouser|Kurta = Shirt, pieces num 1..300
setting shirt_rate money = 40
setting trouser_rate money = 60
setting kurta_rate money = 55
let pay(w sworker) = sum(w.stitched.pieces week where kind = Shirt) * shirt_rate + sum(w.stitched.pieces week where kind = Trouser) * trouser_rate + sum(w.stitched.pieces week where kind = Kurta) * kurta_rate
each sworker sort name as w
  row card tap edit w
    w.name bold grow
    sum(w.stitched.pieces week) "pieces"
    text pay(w) bold
"Weekly payroll" sum(sworker, pay(it)) big
form stitched, "Pieces done"
form sworker, "Add worker"

    "Not ready" head

table album client text, pages num 10..250 = 30, due date, rounds num 0..20 = 0, approved bool
let done = count(album where approved = yes)
topbar album, "Add album"
goal done, max(count(album), 1), "albums approved"
each album sort due as a empty "No albums in proof. Add one when you send the first draft."
  stack card gap 2 tap edit a swipe remove a
    row
      a.client bold grow
      a.pages "pages" faint
    row gap 2
      "Due" a.due faint color if(a.due < today and a.approved = no, bad, muted)
      plural(a.rounds, "round") "of changes" bold color if(a.rounds > 2, warn, ink)
    if a.approved
      "Approved" bold color good
    else
      row gap 1
        button "They want changes" tap set a.rounds = a.rounds + 1
        button "Approved" fill accent tap set a.approved = yes

request: add Purple to the colour please
program_before:
app "Bookshelf" book mint
table book title text, pages num 20..2000 = 200, colour pick Blue|Green|Orange|Red|Grey = Blue, rating num 1..5, notes long?
state sel text = ""
scroll
  each book sort title
    box width 36 height 100 radius 3 fill if(it.colour = Blue, accent, if(it.colour = Green, good, if(it.colour = Orange, warn, if(it.colour = Red, bad, muted)))) tap set sel = it.title
      it.title tiny color bg
each book where title = sel
  stack card gap 1
    it.title head

state score num = 0

  cq.question big

  button cq.b tap set score = score + if(cq.right = B, 1, 0) then set i = i + 1
